¿Qué dejarás atrás? 
  
Spiritfarer es un juego de gestión sobre la muerte. Eres Stella, guía de los espíritus, y la maestre de un ferri que transporta a los muertos. Construye un barco para explorar el mundo, hazte amiga de los espíritus y cuida de ellos antes de guiarlos hasta el más allá. Cultiva, extrae recursos, pesca, cosecha, cocina y fabrica en los mares místicos. Únete a la aventura como el gato Daffodil en el modo cooperativo para dos jugadores. Diviértete y relájate con los espíritus pasajeros, crea recuerdos inolvidables y aprende a despedirte de los que más quieres.
 
  La edición Farewell de Spiritfarer es la edición definitiva de este juego de gestión sobre la muerte. Te ofrece el juego base que ya ha cautivado a más de un millón de jugadores, además de todo el contenido adicional publicado hasta la fecha. Descubre por qué Spiritfarer es uno de los mejores juegos del 2020 según la crítica.
 
Características: 
   
• Disfruta de gráficos y animaciones diseñados a mano.
   • Construye, gestiona y mejora tu propio ferri. 
   • ¡Cultiva, extrae recursos, pesca, cosecha, cocina, teje, fabrica y mucho más! ¡Hay un montón de actividades distintas esperándote!
   • Conoce a un gran elenco de personajes memorables, súbelos a bordo, cuídalos y forja relaciones con ellos.
   • Corre, salta y ábrete camino por exquisitos niveles de plataforma. 
   • Explora un fantástico mundo como jamás habías imaginado. Busca y reúne recursos para crear mejoras para tu barco y regalos para los pasajeros. 
   • Vive emotivas historias, plagadas de momentos inolvidables.
   • Sumérgete durante horas en un mundo tranquilo y agradable. Acabarlo te llevará unas 30 horas, pero necesitarás muchísimas más para experimentar todo lo que Spiritfarer puede ofrecerte.
   • Aprovecha al máximo las opciones de personalización para el barco, tu personaje ¡e incluso el gato!
   • Juega como el gato Daffodil en el modo cooperativo local opcional.
   • Incluye el magnífico juego base y tres actualizaciones de contenido muy importantes: ¡explora un mundo mayor y traba amistad con las nuevas almas!

Que restera-t-il de vous ? 
  
Spiritfarer est un jeu de gestion cosy sur le thème de la mort, dans lequel vous incarnez Stella la Navigatrice, une passeuse d’âmes. Construisez un bateau pour explorer le monde, puis liez-vous d’amitié avec les esprits et prenez soin d’eux avant de les mener vers l’au-delà. Cultivez, prospectez, pêchez, récoltez, cuisinez et fabriquez tout ce dont vous aurez besoin pour traverser des mers mystiques. Vous pouvez également incarner Daffodil le chat pour une aventure en mode coopératif à deux joueurs. Partagez des moments privilégiés avec vos défunts passagers, façonnez des souvenirs inoubliables et apprenez comment dire adieu à vos chers amis.
 
  L'édition Farewell de Spiritfarer est l'édition définitive du jeu primé de gestion cosy sur le thème de la mort. Elle inclut le jeu de base tant adoré par près de 1 million de joueurs, et tous les contenus supplémentaires publiés à ce jour. Découvrez pourquoi la critique a désigné Spiritfarer comme l'un des meilleurs jeux de 2020.
 
Caractéristiques : 
   
• De superbes animations et graphismes dessinés à la main.
   • Construisez, gérez et améliorez votre bateau. 
   • Cultivez, prospectez, pêchez, récoltez, cuisinez, tissez et fabriquez ce dont vous avez besoin. C’est tout un éventail d’activités qui vous attend !
   • Rencontrez de nombreux personnages hauts en couleur, prenez-les à bord et sous votre aile, et liez-vous d’amitié avec eux.
   • Courez, sautez et glissez à travers des niveaux de plateforme à la conception élégante. 
   • Explorez un monde imaginaire fantastique. Trouvez et collectez des ressources pour améliorer votre bateau et fabriquer des cadeaux pour vos passagers. 
   • Vivez des histoires émouvantes remplies de moments inoubliables.
   • Détendez-vous au long de nombreuses heures de jeu. Il vous en faudra trente pour arriver à la fin, et plus de 50 pour découvrir tout ce que Spiritfarer a à vous offrir.
   • Façonnez l’aventure à votre goût grâce aux nombreuses possibilités de personnalisation du bateau, de votre personnage, et même du chat !
   • Incarnez Daffodil le chat en mode coopératif local. Remote Play supporté!  
    • Inclut le jeu de base émouvant et trois mises à jour de contenu majeures : explorez un monde étendu et liez-vous d'amitié avec quatre nouveaux esprits !

Was wirst du zurücklassen? 
  
Spiritfarer ist ein gemütliches Management-Spiel über das Sterben. Du spielst Stella, den Fährmann der Verstorbenen, ein sogenannter Spiritfarer. Baue ein Boot, um die Welt zu erkunden. Freunde dich dann mit Geistern an und kümmere dich um sie, bevor du sie schließlich ins Jenseits entlässt. Bebaue Felder, betreibe Minen, fische, ernte, koche und finde deinen Weg über mystische Meere. Schließe dich dem Abenteuer im kooperativen Modus für zwei Spieler als Daffodil die Katze an. Verbringe eine entspannte, tolle Zeit mit deinen Geisterpassagieren, erschaffe bleibende Erinnerungen und lerne schließlich, deinen geschätzten Freunden Lebewohl zu sagen.
 
  Die Farewell-Edition von Spiritfarer ist die vollständige Edition des preisgekrönten gemütlichen Management-Spiels über das Sterben. Es bietet das von über einer Million Spielern geliebte Grundspiel und alle bisher veröffentlichten zusätzlichen Inhalte. Erlebe selbst, warum Spiritfarer von der Kritik als eines der besten Spiele des Jahres 2020 gefeiert wurde.
 
        Features: 

   • Genieße wunderschöne, handgemalte Grafik und Animation.
   • Baue, manage und verbessere deine eigene Fähre 
   • Bebaue Felder, betreibe Minen, fische, ernte, koche, webe und fertige Objekte. Eine unbegrenzte Vielzahl an Aktivitäten erwartet dich!
   • Triff unvergessliche Charaktere, hol sie an Bord, sorge für sie und baue Beziehungen zu ihnen auf.
   • Laufe, springe und gleite auf deinem Weg durch elegant konstruierte Plattform-Levels. 
   • Erkunde eine fantastische und fantasievolle Welt. Suche und sammle Ressourcen, um Verbesserungen für dein Schiff und Geschenke für deine Passagiere herzustellen. 
   • Erlebe bewegende, emotionale Geschichten voller unvergesslicher Momente.
   • Verbringe eine angenehme und entspannende Spielzeit: 30 Stunden bis zum Abschluss und mehr als 50 weitere, um alles zu entdecken, was Spiritfarer zu bieten hat.
   • Mache das Abenteuer mit reichhaltigen Anpassungsmöglichkeiten für dein Boot, deinen Charakter und sogar für die Katze zu deinem eigenen Erlebnis!
   • Spiele im optionalen lokalen Koop-Modus als Daffodil die Katze.

O que deixarás para trás? 
  
Spiritfarer é um acolhedor jogo de gestão sobre a morte. És Stella, a timoneira do ferry dos mortos, também conhecida como Spiritfarer. Cuida dos amigáveis espíritos que conheceres, melhora o teu ferry para explorar o mundo e guia os espíritos até os libertares no pós-vida. Planta, explora minas, pesca, colhe, cozinha e cria através dos mares místicos. Junta-te à aventura na pele de Daffodil, o gato, no modo cooperativo para dois jogadores. Relaxa junto dos espíritos que transportas, cria memórias duradouras e, eventualmente, aprende a dizer adeus aos teus amigos.
 
  Spiritfarer Edição Farewell é a versão definitiva do acolhedor e premiado jogo de gestão sobre a morte. Junta o jogo base que cativou mais de 1 milhão de jogadores e todos os conteúdos adicionais lançados até à data. Fica a saber o que levou os críticos a aclamá-lo como um dos melhores jogos de 2020.
 
        Caraterísticas: 
   
• Desfruta de visuais e animação belíssimos desenhados à mão.
   • Cria, gere e melhora o teu próprio ferry. 
   • Planta, explora minas, pesca, colhe, cozinha, tece, cria! Esperam por ti inúmeras atividades!
   • Conhece, transporta, cuida e trava amizades com um elenco cheio de personagens memoráveis.
   • Corre, salta e desliza através dos elegantes níveis de plataformas. 
   • Explora um mundo de fantasia e imaginação. Procura e obtém recursos para criar melhorias para o ferry e prendas para os passageiros. 
   • Fica a conhecer histórias emocionantes cheias de momentos memoráveis.
   • Relaxa por horas a fio com a sua jogabilidade acolhedora. O jogo dura 30 horas, mas precisarás de mais de 50 para descobrires tudo aquilo que tem para oferecer.
   • Dá um toque pessoal à aventura graças às inúmeras opções de personalização do ferry, da personagem e até do gato!
   • Entra na pele do gato Daffodil no modo cooperativo local opcional.
   • Inclui o cativante jogo base e três grandes atualizações de conteúdos: explora um mundo ainda maior e fica a conhecer quatro novos espíritos amigáveis!

Hvad vil du efterlade? 

  Spiritfarer er et hyggeligt management-spil om at dø. Du spiller Stella, færgemand for de døde, en Spiritfarer. Byg en båd for at udforske verden, find åndevenner og tage dig af dem, før du til sidst frigiver dem til livet efter døden. Lav gård- og minearbejde, høst, fisk og lav mad, og brug dine evner til at kommer over mystiske vande. Gå ind i eventyret som katten Daffodil i et samarbejdsspil for to spillere. Tag lidt afslappende kvalitetstid med dine åndepassagerer, skab varige minder, og lær i sidste ende at sige farvel dine elskede venner.
 
  Spiritfarer Farewell Edition er den definitive udgave af det prisvindende hyggelige management-spil om at dø. Det samler basisspillet, der er elsket af over 1 million spillere, og alt det ekstra indhold, der er udgivet til dato. Se, hvorfor kritikere kaldte Spiritfarer for et af de bedste spil i 2020.
 
        Funktioner: 

   • Nyd smuk håndtegnet grafik og animation.
   • Byg, styr og forbedr din egen færge. 
   • Lav gård- og minearbejde, fisk, høst og lav mad, vævning og håndværk! En endeløs række af aktiviteter venter dig!
   • Mød, byd ombord, tag dig af, og opbyg venskaber med en række mindeværdige figurer.
   • Løb, spring, og glid dig vej igennem elegant konstruerede platformniveauer. 
   • Udforsk en forrygende og fantasifuld verden. Søg og saml ressourcer for at fremstille opgraderinger af dit skib og gaver til dine passagerer. 
   • Oplev bevægende, følelsesladede historer fyldt med uforglemmelige øjeblikke.
   • Slap af i timevis i hyggeligt og afslappende gameplay. 30 timer til at fuldføre, +50 til at opleve alt det, Spiritfarer kan tilbyde.
   • Gør eventyret til dit eget med masser af tilpasningsmuligheder til din båd og figur, ja selv til katten!
   • Spil som katten Daffodil i valgfri, lokal samarbejdsspil.
   • Indeholder det hjertevarmende basisspil og tre store indholdsopdateringer: Udforsk en udvidet verden og bliv venner med fire nye spirituelle venner!

Cosa ti lascerai alle spalle? 

  Spiritfarer è un placido gioco gestionale sul tema della morte. Nel ruolo di Stella, traghettatrice dei defunti, costruisci una barca per esplorare il mondo, quindi prenditi cura degli spiriti fino a condurli all’agognato oltrevita. Coltiva, estrai, pesca, raccogli, cucina e crea per riuscire ad attraversare i mari mistici. Unisciti all’avventura nel ruolo di Daffodil il gatto per giocare in modalità cooperativa. Trascorri del tempo con i tuoi passeggeri, stringendo legami che non dimenticherai, fino ad arrivare a porgere l’ultimo saluto ai tuoi eterni amici.
 
  L'Edizione Farewell di Spiritfarer è la versione definitiva del premiato gestionale sul tema della morte. Include il gioco base, apprezzato da oltre un milione di giocatori, e tutti i contenuti aggiuntivi pubblicati finora. Scopri perché la critica ha considerato Spiritfarer uno dei migliori giochi del 2020.
 
        Caratteristiche: 

   • Disegni e animazioni realizzati a mano.
   • Costruisci, gestisci e migliora la tua barca. 
   • Coltiva, estrai, pesca, raccogli, cucina, intessi e crea! Una lunga serie di attività ti attendono!
   • Accogli a bordo e impara a conoscere un cast di personaggi memorabili.
   • Corri, salta e plana attraverso livelli platform di rara eleganza. 
   • Esplora un mondo fantastico e sorprendente, quindi raccogli risorse per creare potenziamenti per la tua barca e doni per i tuoi passeggeri. 
   • Ripercorri storie di vita emozionanti, piene di momenti indimenticabili.
   • Abbandonati ai ritmi di un gameplay rilassante. Il gioco richiede circa 30 ore per giungere alla fine, e più di 50 per scoprire tutto quanto ha da offrire.
   • Rendi unica la tua avventura personalizzando la barca, la protagonista e persino il gatto!
   • Gioca nel ruolo di Daffodil nella modalità cooperativa locale. 
   • Include il gioco base e tre aggiornamenti pieni di contenuti: esplora un mondo sempre più ampio e conosci quattro nuovi spiriti!

Spiritfarer is a cozy management game about dying. As ferrymaster to the deceased, build a boat to explore the world, care for your spirit friends, and release them into the afterlife. The Spiritfarer Farewell Edition includes the heartwarming base game and three major content updates.

Spiritfarer is a cozy management game about dying. You play Stella, ferrymaster to the deceased, a Spiritfarer. Build a boat to explore the world, then befriend and care for spirits before finally releasing them into the afterlife. Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, and craft your way across mystical seas. Join the adventure as Daffodil the cat, in two-player cooperative play. Spend relaxing quality time with your spirit passengers, create lasting memories, and, ultimately, learn how to say goodbye to your cherished friends. What will you leave behind?

You play Stella, ferrymaster to the deceased, a Spiritfarer. Build a boat to explore the world, pick up spirits, and release them into the afterlife. Gather, produce, and consume resources while you guide your passengers across mystical seas. Join the adventure as Daffodil the cat, in two-player cooperative play. Spend relaxing quality time with your spirit passengers, building and tending to your relationships, and, ultimately, learn how to say goodbye to your cherished friends.

        Features: 
   
• Enjoy beautiful hand-drawn art and animation.
 • Build, manage, and improve your own ferry. 
  • Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, weave, craft! An endless variety of activities await you!
  • Meet, take on board, care for, and forge relationships with a cast of memorable characters.
   • Run, jump, and glide your way through elegantly constructed platforming levels. 
   • Explore a fantastic and imaginative world. Seek and gather resources to craft upgrades for your ship and gifts for your passengers. 
   • Experience moving, emotional stories filled with unforgettable moments.
   • Unwind for hours into cozy and relaxing gameplay. 30 hours to finish, 50+ to experience everything Spiritfarer has to offer.
   • Make the adventure your own with rich customization options for your boat, character, even the cat!
    • Play as Daffodil the cat in optional local co-op. Supports Remote Play Together. 
    • Includes the heartwarming base game and three major content updates: explore an expanded world and befriend four new spirit friends!

game.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
game.description:
Trained from early childhood and mutated to gain superhuman skills, strength, and reflexes, witchers are a counterbalance to the monster-infested world in which they live.

• Gruesomely destroy foes as a professional monster hunter armed with a range of upgradeable weapons, mutating potions, and combat magic.
• Hunt down a wide variety of exotic monsters, from savage beasts prowling mountain passes to cunning supernatural predators lurking in the shadowy back alleys of densely populated cities.
• Invest your rewards to upgrade your weaponry and buy custom armor, or spend them on horse races, card games, fist fighting, and other pleasures life brings.
  
Built for endless adventure, the massive open world of The Witcher sets new standards in terms of size, depth, and complexity.

• Traverse a fantastical open world: explore forgotten ruins, caves, and shipwrecks, trade with merchants and dwarven smiths in cities, and hunt across the open plains, mountains, and seas.
• Deal with treasonous generals, devious witches, and corrupt royalty to provide dark and dangerous services.
• Make choices that go beyond good & evil, and face their far-reaching consequences.
  
Take on the most important contract of your life: to track down the child of prophecy, the key to saving or destroying this world.

• In times of war, chase down the child of prophecy, a living weapon foretold by ancient elven legends.
• Struggle against ferocious rulers, spirits of the wilds, and even a threat from beyond the veil – all hell-bent on controlling this world.
• Define your destiny in a world that may not be worth saving.

This edition of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt has been enhanced with numerous visual and technical improvements, including vastly improved level of detail, a range of community created and newly developed mods for the game, real-time ray tracing, and more — all implemented with the power of modern PCs in mind.
  
   
  Trained from early childhood and mutated to gain superhuman skills, strength, and reflexes, witchers are a counterbalance to the monster-infested world in which they live.
  • Gruesomely destroy foes as a professional monster hunter armed with a range of upgradeable weapons, mutating potions, and combat magic.
  • Hunt down a wide variety of exotic monsters, from savage beasts prowling mountain passes to cunning supernatural predators lurking in the shadowy back alleys of densely populated cities.
  • Invest your rewards to upgrade your weaponry and buy custom armor, or spend them on horse races, card games, fist fighting, and other pleasures life brings.
  
   
  Built for endless adventure, the massive open world of The Witcher sets new standards in terms of size, depth, and complexity.
  • Traverse a fantastical open world: explore forgotten ruins, caves, and shipwrecks, trade with merchants and dwarven smiths in cities, and hunt across the open plains, mountains, and seas.
  • Deal with treasonous generals, devious witches, and corrupt royalty to provide dark and dangerous services.
  • Make choices that go beyond good & evil, and face their far-reaching consequences.
  
   
  Take on the most important contract of your life: to track down the child of prophecy, the key to saving or destroying this world.
  • In times of war, chase down the child of prophecy, a living weapon foretold by ancient elven legends.
  • Struggle against ferocious rulers, spirits of the wilds, and even a threat from beyond the veil – all hell-bent on controlling this world.
  • Define your destiny in a world that may not be worth saving.
《巫师3：狂猎》将是三部曲系列的最后一作，故事将有宏大的最后结局，但并非《巫师》系列的最终作。本作采用最新的REDengine3引擎制作，玩家可以在无缝的世界里任意探索，采用非线性剧情的设定，整体规模是前作的30倍。

《巫师3：狂猎》是一款由波兰游戏工作室CD Projekt RED开发并发行的开放世界动作角色扮演游戏，于2013年2月公布。游戏于2015年5月19日在Microsoft Windows、PlayStation 4和Xbox One平台发布，这也是首款在PlayStation平台发布的巫师系列游戏。

本作是巫师系列的第三部作品，同样改编自波兰奇幻小说作家安杰伊·萨普科夫斯基的同名系列小说（中译《猎魔人》），但剧情发生在小说之后。游戏在商业上取得了成功并受到了广泛的赞誉，在六周内销量超过600万，亦获得2015年游戏大奖的最佳年度游戏，以及最佳角色扮演游戏。

本作是一款情节驱动的开放世界角色扮演游戏。故事发生在一个令人目眩神迷的奇幻宇宙里，玩家做出的每一个选择都意义重大，同时也要面对影响深远的后果。在《巫师》这个广袤的开放世界中，您可以尽情探索商业都市、海盗岛屿、危险的山隘和被遗忘的洞窟。而随着北方领域战乱四起，您接下了此生最为重大的一笔委托：找到预言之子，一件足以改变世界面貌的活生生的武器。

◇ 扮演一名训练有素，收钱办事的怪物杀手
猎魔人身处的世界怪物横行。作为一支制衡力量，他们自小接受训练，通过变异来获得超人类的战斗技巧、力量和反应。
扮演一名职业怪物杀手，装备一系列可以升级的武器、变种魔药和战斗法术，无情地把对手大卸八块。
凶残的野兽徘徊于山间，狡猾的灵异掠食者潜伏在人烟稠密的城镇暗处，而您则要捕杀这些各色的奇异怪物。
把您赚取的奖赏用来升级武器，购买订制的盔甲，或者花在赛马、打牌、拳击，还有其它的夜间娱乐生活上。

◇ 探索道德沦丧的开放式奇幻世界
巫师宏大的开放世界为玩家带来无尽的冒险，并且在规模、深度和复杂性等方面树立了新的标准。
遍历奇幻的开放世界：探索被遗忘的废墟、洞穴和沉船，与城市里的商人和矮人工匠做买卖，在开阔的平原、山地和海洋上进行狩猎。
与谋反的将领、阴险的女巫还有腐败的皇室打交道，替他们去完成见不得光的危险勾当。
做出超越善恶的选择，直面影响深远的后果。

◇ 追寻预言之子
接下最为重要的一笔委托，追寻预言之子。那是一个可以拯救或是摧毁这个世界的关键。
根据古代精灵的预言，预言之子强大无比，是一件活生生的武器。而您则要在纷飞的战火中找到对方的下落。
和一心想要控制这个世界的残暴统治者、野外的精怪，乃至于来自来世的威胁斗智斗勇。
在这个或许并不值得拯救的世界里，左右自己的命运。

◇ 次世代机能的全面发挥
专为次世代硬件量身打造的 REDengine 3，把《巫师》的逼真奇幻世界渲染得细腻生动。
动态的天气系统和日夜循环，将会改变城镇居民以及野外怪兽的行为模式。
通过主线和支线的丰富剧情选择，玩家可以通过前所未有的方式，影响这个宏大的开放世界。

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is an open-world action role-playing game developed by CD Projekt Red.

Set in a dark fantasy world, the game follows Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter searching for his adopted daughter, Ciri, while navigating political conflicts and supernatural threats. Gameplay features exploration, combat, character progression, and branching narratives shaped by player choices. Widely acclaimed for its writing, world-building, and depth, it is considered one of the most influential RPGs of its generation.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt concludes the story of the witcher Geralt of Rivia, the series' protagonist, whose story to date has been covered in the previous installments. Geralt's new mission comes in dark times as the mysterious and otherworldly army known as the Wild Hunt invades the Northern Kingdoms, leaving only blood soaked earth and fiery ruin in its wake; and it seems the Witcher is the key to stopping their cataclysmic rampage.

  Infos zum Spiel  Eines der preisgekröntesten Rollenspiele aller Zeiten Jetzt bereit für die neue Generation.
   
  Du bist Geralt von Riva, Monsterschlächter und Söldner. Vor dir erstreckt sich ein vom Krieg zerrütteter und von Monstern befallener Kontinent, den du nach Belieben erkunden kannst. Dein aktueller Auftrag? Finde Ciri, das Kind der Prophezeiung – eine lebende Waffe mit der Macht, die Welt zu verändern.
  
  Mit dem Update auf die neueste Version beinhaltet The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt neue Features und Extras wie den integrierten Fotomodus, neue Gegenstände (Schwerter, Rüstung, alternative Outfits), die von der Netflix-Serie The Witcher inspiriert wurden, und noch mehr!
  
   
  Erlebe die düstere Fantasy-Welt des Kontinents wie nie zuvor! Diese Edition von The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt beinhaltet zahlreiche grafische und technische Verbesserungen, darunter viel höhere Detaildichte, mehrere neu entwickelte oder von der Community geschaffene Mods, Echtzeit-Raytracing und mehr – alles mit Blick auf die Leistungsstärke modernder PCs umgesetzt!
  
   
  Hexer wurden seit ihrer Kindheit trainiert und durchliefen Mutationen, um übermenschliche Fähigkeiten, Stärke und Reflexe zu erlangen – nur so haben sie eine Chance gegen die Monster ihrer Welt.
  • Zerstöre deine Gegner als professioneller Monsterjäger, der mit verschiedenen Waffen, Mutationstränken und Kampfmagie ausgestattet ist.
  • Jage eine Vielzahl exotischer Monster, von wilden Bestien an Bergpässen bis hin zu gerissenen übernatürlichen Raubtieren, die in den dunklen Gassen dicht besiedelter Städte lauern.
  • Nutze deine Belohnungen, um deine Waffen zu verbessern und besondere Rüstungen zu kaufen, oder gib dein Geld für Pferderennen, Kartenspiele, Faustkämpfe und sonstige Unterhaltung aus.
  
   
  Die riesige Open World von The Witcher bietet dir endlose Abenteuer und setzt neue Maßstäbe, was Größe, Tiefe und Komplexität angeht.
  • Durchquere eine fantastische Welt: Erkunde vergessene Ruinen, Höhlen und Schiffswracks, handle mit Kaufleuten und zwergischen Schmieden in Städten und jage auf Ebenen, in Bergen und auf dem Meer.
  • Triff auf hinterhältige Generäle, verschlagene Hexen und korrupte Adlige, denen du gefährliche Dienste anbietest.
  • Triff Entscheidungen, die nicht einfach gut oder böse sind und weitreichende Konsequenzen haben.
  
   
  Nimm den wichtigsten Auftrag deines Lebens an – finde das Kind der Prophezeiung, das die Welt retten oder zerstören wird.
  • Spüre mitten im Krieg das Kind der Prophezeiung auf, eine lebende Waffe aus uralten elfischen Legenden.
  • Tritt gnadenlosen Herrschern, Naturgeistern und sogar einer Bedrohung von jenseits des Schleiers entgegen – die allesamt diese Welt kontrollieren wollen.
  • Bestimme dein Schicksal in einer Welt, die es nicht verdient, gerettet zu werden.

PAYDAY 2是一款动作类四人合作射击游戏，各位玩家将再次扮演初代PAYDAY帮成员——达拉斯、霍斯顿、沃尔夫以及钱恩斯——并前往华盛顿特区展开一系列惊险刺激的劫案。
 
 CRIMENET网络提供了大量动态合约，玩家们可以自由选择打劫小型便利店或绑架人质，又或是执行大规模的网络犯罪或洗劫大型银行金库，掠取巨额收益。另外既然身处首都，何不在当地打好关系，顺便参与一些政治事务呢？
 
 每场劫案共有四名玩家可同时进行，并且随着玩家自身的不断成长，劫案难度与奖励也会不断提升。除了赚取一笔大钱成为传奇罪犯之外，还有目不暇接的角色自定义与制作系统，包括各项人物成长以及枪械和装备改造等着你来探索。 游戏亮点   抢银行，赚大钱 - 玩家需要仔细选择全队搭配，一旦劫案中情况有变，便需要各自本事与良好协作来迎接挑战。
   CRIMENET - 动态合约库使各位玩家可以联系各位合约人挑选心仪的劫案，这几位合约人包括乌克兰人弗拉德、油滑的政客“大象”、南美毒贩赫克特等等，他们各有自己的组织，并且经手的生意范畴也有所区别。
   全新升级的PAYDAY枪战机制 - 武器开火与捆绑人质的体验是你从未有过的全新感受。
   动态场景变化 - 一千位玩家能玩出一千种不同的劫案。每次场景中都有着些许变化或是稀有事件出现。
   选择你的技能 - 玩家在游戏过程中可以从以下五条技能树中累积能力：黑手、暴徒、技师、幽灵与逃犯。每条技能树均有着独特的定制化技能与装备获取，通过有效搭配便能使玩家成长为终极劫匪。
   面具数量再创新高 - PAYDAY 2加入了全新的面具系统，玩家现在可以选用自己喜爱的花纹与配色制作专属于自己的独特面具，从而创造出千变万化的不同组合。
   武器与改装 - 劫匪们将拥有自己的庞大军火库，从着重于远距离的狙击步枪与突击步枪到强调近身作战的手枪与冲锋枪等等。在你选定自己心仪的武器后，你还可以为其添加一系列包括瞄镜、消音器、前握把、准星、枪管、枪身以及枪托在内等方面俱到的模组改装，使你的武器达到最佳性能。此外还有完全基于审美意义上的改进内容——给你的爱枪换上胡桃木握把，让自己变成刀尖舔血的大毒枭范儿吧！
   游戏方式由你选择 - 每场劫案都有多种方式完成。你可以选择神不知鬼不觉地潜入目标地点完成任务，或是抄起家伙正面发动攻势。每种选择都会给你带来截然不同的体验。
   海量额外内容 - 自从游戏发布后已有70余项更新，其中包括新劫案、角色、武器以及其他游戏特性例如驾驶汽车和叉车等等。

PAYDAY 2 is an action-packed, four-player co-op shooter that once again lets gamers don the masks of the original PAYDAY crew - Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf and Chains - as they descend on Washington DC for an epic crime spree. 
 
 The CRIMENET network offers a huge range of dynamic contracts, and players are free to choose anything from small-time convenience store hits or kidnappings, to big league cyber-crime or emptying out major bank vaults for that epic PAYDAY. While in DC, why not participate in the local community, and run a few political errands?
 
 Up to four friends co-operate on the hits, and as the crew progresses the jobs become bigger, better and more rewarding. Along with earning more money and becoming a legendary criminal comes a character customization and crafting system that lets crews build and customize their own guns and gear. Key Features   Rob Banks, Get Paid – Players must choose their crew carefully, because when the job goes down they will need the right mix of skills on their side.
   CRIMENET – The dynamic contract database lets gamers pick and choose from available jobs by connecting with local contacts such as Vlad the Ukrainian, shady politician "The Elephant", and South American drug trafficker Hector, all with their own agenda and best interests in mind.
   PAYDAY Gunplay and Mechanics on a New Level – Firing weapons and zip tying civilians never felt so good.
   Dynamic Scenarios – No heist ever plays out the same way twice. Every single scenario has random geometry or even rare events.
   Choose Your Skills – As players progress they can invest in any of five special Skill Trees: Mastermind, Enforcer, Ghost, Technician and Fugitive. Each features a deep customization tree of associated skills and equipment to master, and they can be mixed and matched to create the ultimate heister.
   More Masks than Ever – PAYDAY 2 features a completely new mask system, giving players the ability to craft their own unique mask with a pattern and color of their choice, resulting in millions of different combinations.  
   Weapons and Modifications – A brand new arsenal for the serious heister, covering everything from sniper and assault rifles to compact PDWs and SMGs. Once you've settled for a favorite, you can modify it with optics, suppressors, fore grips, reticles, barrels, frames, stocks and more, all of which will affect the performance of your weapon. There are also purely aesthetic enhancements - why not go for the drug lord look with polished walnut grips for your nine?
   Play It Your Way – Each job allows for multiple approaches, such as slow and stealthy ambushes or running in guns blazing. Hit the target any way you want, each approach will provide a different experience.
   A Long History of Additional Content – More than 70 updates since release, including new heists, characters, weapons and other gameplay features like driving cars and forklifts.

PAYDAY 2 es un juego de acción cooperativo para cuatro jugadores que, una vez más, permite a los jugadores ponerse en la piel del equipo original de PAYDAY - Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf y Chains - mientras descienden por Washington DC en una épica ola de crímenes.
 
 La red CRIMENET ofrece una amplia gama de contratos dinámicos, y los jugadores son libres de elegir cualquier cosa, desde pequeños atracos a tiendas de conveniencia o secuestros, hasta grandes ciberdelitos o vaciar importantes cámaras acorazadas para ese épico PAYDAY. Y mientras estás en DC, ¿por qué no participas en la comunidad local y haces algunos encargos políticos?
 
 Hasta cuatro amigos cooperan en los golpes y, a medida que el equipo avanza, los trabajos se hacen más grandes, mejores y más gratificantes. Además de ganar más dinero y convertirse en un criminal legendario, existe un sistema de personalización y creación de personajes que permite a los equipos construir y personalizar sus propias armas y equipamiento. Características principales   Atraca bancos, recibe una paga - Los jugadores deben elegir a su equipo con cuidado, ya que necesitarán la combinación correcta de habilidades de su lado cuando el trabajo comience.
   CRIMENET - La base de datos dinámica de contratos permite a los jugadores escoger entre los trabajos disponibles al conectarse con contactos locales como Vlad el ucraniano, el político sombrío "El Elefante" y el narcotraficante sudamericano Héctor, todos con su propia agenda y sus propios intereses en mente.
   PAYDAY, disparos y mecánicas a un nuevo nivel - Disparar armas y atacar a civiles nunca se sintió tan bien.
   Escenarios dinámicos - Ningún atraco se juega de la misma manera dos veces. Cada escenario tiene una geometría aleatoria o incluso eventos raros.
   Elige tus habilidades - A medida que los jugadores progresan, pueden invertir en cualquiera de los cinco árboles de habilidades especiales: Mente Maestra, Matón, Fantasma, Técnico y Fugitivo. Cada uno presenta un árbol de personalización de habilidades y equipos asociados para dominar, y se pueden mezclar y combinar para crear el mejor asaltante.
   Más máscaras que nunca - PAYDAY 2 presenta un sistema de máscaras completamente nuevo, que brinda a los jugadores la capacidad de crear su propia máscara única con un patrón y un color a elección, lo que resulta en millones de combinaciones diferentes.  
   Armas y modificaciones - Un nuevo arsenal para el asaltante serio, que abarca desde fusiles de francotirador y asalto, hasta armas de defensa personal y subfusiles. Una vez que hayas elegido alguno de estos, puedes modificarlo con ópticas, supresores, empuñaduras, retículas, barriles, culatas, cargadores y más, lo cual afectará el rendimiento de tu arma. También hay mejoras puramente estéticas - ¿Por qué no optar por el aspecto del capo de la droga con culata de nogal pulido para tu arma?
   Juega a tu manera - Cada trabajo permite múltiples estrategias, como emboscadas lentas y sigilosas o correr con armas de fuego. Alcanza el objetivo de la forma que quieras. Cada estrategia proporcionará una experiencia diferente.
   Una larga historia de contenido adicional - Más de 70 actualizaciones desde su lanzamiento, incluidos nuevos atracos, personajes, armas y otras características de juego como conducir automóviles y vehículos de carga.

PAYDAY 2 est un jeu de tir coopératif bourré d'action qui permet jusqu'à quatre joueurs d'incarner une fois de plus les braqueurs originaux du célèbre gang PAYDAY, Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf et Chains, qui débarquent à Washington DC pour une série de crimes épiques.
 
 Le nouveau réseau CRIMENET offre une vaste gamme de contrats dynamiques : les joueurs sont libres de choisir la nature des contrats qui les intéressent, allant de forfaits relativement rapides à exécuter, tels que des vols de bijouteries ou des kidnappings, à des cybercrimes ou des braquages complexes nécessitant des plans bien échafaudés pour vider les coffres des plus grandes banques. Puisque vous êtes en ville, pourquoi ne pas en profiter pour soutenir votre candidat préféré en tant que bon citoyen ?
 
 Jusqu'à quatre amis peuvent coopérer sur les différents casses. À mesure que vous progressez, les contrats deviennent plus audacieux et risqués, mais surtout plus gratifiants. En plus de gagner de l'argent et de devenir un criminel légendaire, vous pouvez aussi personnaliser les braqueurs à l'aide d'un système d'artisanat qui vous permet de modifier les armes et l'équipement du gang. Fonctionnalités   Braquez des banques entre amis - Choisissez votre équipe avec précaution, coordonnez-vous pour sélectionner les compétences adéquates ou le contrat s'annoncera très difficile !
   CRIMENET - La base de données des contrats permet aux joueurs de choisir parmi les jobs disponibles en se mettant en relation avec des contacts locaux tels que Vlad l'Ukrainien, "L'Éléphant", un politicien véreux, ou encore Hector, un trafiquant de drogue colombien, tous ayant leur propre façon de faire et leur type de contrat préféré.
   Des sensations inouïes - Avec le rendu visuel et sonore fantastique de PAYDAY, tirer avec une arme et attacher les mains d'un civil n'a jamais été aussi jouissif.
   Scénarios dynamiques - Chaque scénario dispose d'une géométrie aléatoire et d'événements uniques. Un contrat peut être joué plusieurs fois, mais ne le sera jamais deux fois de la même façon.
   Choisissez votre spécialité - En progressant, les joueurs peuvent se spécialiser dans l'un des cinq types de braqueur : Cerveau, Exécuteur, Fantôme, Technicien ou Fugitif. Chacun possède son arbre de compétences qui offre des talents et des équipements uniques. Combinez les arbres pour créer le braqueur ultime.
   Des masques à foison - PAYDAY 2 possède un système de personnalisation inédit qui permet à ses joueurs de créer un masque sans pareil en y appliquant le motif et les couleurs de leur choix. Les possibilités sont presque infinies !
   Armes et modifications - Un tout nouvel arsenal pour les braqueurs exigeant, offrant un choix pléthorique de fusils de précisions, de fusils d'assaut, de carabines et autres mitraillettes compactes. Après avoir jeté votre dévolu, il est possible de modifier votre arme : viseur, silencieux, poignée, réticule, canon, châssis, crosse et bien plus, ce qui aura une incidence sur les performances de l'arme. Il existe également des améliorations purement esthétiques : pourquoi ne pas vous la jouer façon baron de la drogue en ajoutant une poignée en noyer poli à votre 9 mm ?
   À vous de jouer - Choisissez votre façon de procéder : lente et furtive ou rapide et bourrine ? Chaque approche vous offre une expérience différente.
   Une longue histoire - Depuis sa sortie, le jeu a bénéficié de plus de 70 mises à jour, incluant de nouveaux casses, personnages, armes et fonctionnalités telles que la conduite de voitures et de chariots élévateurs.

PAYDAY 2 ist ein actiongeladener Vier-Spieler-Koop-Shooter, bei dem die Spieler wieder einmal die Masken der ursprünglichen PAYDAY-Crew - Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf und Chains - aufsetzen können, während sie für eine epische Verbrechensserie nach Washington DC kommen. 
 
 Das CRIMENET-Netzwerk bietet eine riesige Auswahl an dynamischen Verträgen, und die Spieler haben die freie Wahl - von kleinen Überfällen auf Lebensmittelgeschäfte oder Entführungen bis hin zur Cyber-Kriminalität der großen Liga oder dem Leeren großer Banktresore für diese epische PAYDAY. Warum sich während ihres Aufenthalts in DC nicht an der lokalen Gemeinschaft beteiligen und ein paar politische Angelegenheiten erledigen?
 
 Bis zu vier Freunde arbeiten bei den Treffern zusammen, und mit dem Fortschreiten der Crew werden die Aufgaben größer, besser und lohnender. Mit dem Verdienst von mehr Geld und dem Aufstieg zum legendären Kriminellen kommt ein System der Charakteranpassung und des Handwerks, das es den Teams ermöglicht, ihre eigenen Waffen und ihre eigene Ausrüstung zu bauen und anzupassen. Hauptmerkmale   Banken ausrauben, bezahlt werden - Die Spieler müssen ihre Crew sorgfältig auswählen, denn wenn der Job anfängt, brauchen sie die richtige Mischung von Fähigkeiten auf ihrer Seite.  CRIMENET - Die dynamische Vertragsdatenbank ermöglicht es den Spielern, aus den verfügbaren Jobs zu wählen, indem sie mit lokalen Kontakten wie dem Ukrainer Vlad, dem zwielichtigen Politiker "Der Elefant" und dem südamerikanischen Drogenhändler Hector in Verbindung treten, die alle ihre eigene Agenda und ihre eigenen Interessen im Auge haben.
   PAYDAY Schießkunst und Spielmechanik auf neuem Niveau - Waffen abzufeuern und Zivilisten zu fesseln hat sich noch nie so gut angefühlt.
   Dynamische Szenarien - Kein Raubüberfall spielt sich je zweimal auf dieselbe Weise ab. Jedes einzelne Szenario hat eine zufällige Geometrie oder sogar seltene Ereignisse.   Wähle Deine Szenarien. Jedes einzelne Szenario hat eine zufällige Geometrie oder sogar seltene Ereignisse.
   Wähle deine Fertigkeiten - Wenn die Spieler Fortschritte machen, können sie in einen von fünf speziellen Fertigkeitsbäumen investieren: Drahtzieher, Vollstrecker, Geist, Techniker und Flüchtling. Jeder dieser Bäume enthält eine Reihe von Fähigkeiten und Ausrüstungsgegenständen, die es zu meistern gilt, und sie können gemischt und angepasst werden, um den ultimativen Heister zu erschaffen.
   Mehr Masken als je zuvor - PAYDAY 2 bietet ein völlig neues Maskensystem, das es den Spielern ermöglicht, ihre eigene einzigartige Maske mit einem Muster und einer Farbe ihrer Wahl zu gestalten, was zu Millionen verschiedener Kombinationen führt.  
   Waffen und Modifikationen - Ein brandneues Arsenal für den seriösen Heister, das von Scharfschützen- und Sturmgewehren bis hin zu kompakten PDWs und SMGs alles abdeckt. Sobald du dich für einen Favoriten entschieden hast, kannst du ihn mit Optiken, Dämpfern, Vordergriffen, Visieren, Läufen, Rahmen, Schäften und mehr modifizieren, was sich alles auf die Leistung deiner Waffe auswirken wird. Es gibt auch rein ästhetische Verbesserungen - warum nicht den Drogenbosslook mit polierten Nussholzgriffen für Ihre Neuner wählen?
   Spiele es auf deine Weise - Jeder Job erlaubt mehrere Vorgehensweisen, wie langsame und verstohlene Hinterhalte oder das Hineinlaufen in Gewehrsalven. Triff das Ziel auf jede Art und Weise, jede Variante bietet eine andere Erfahrung.
   Eine lange Geschichte mit zusätzlichen Inhalten - Mehr als 70 Updates seit der Veröffentlichung, einschließlich neuer Raubüberfälle, Charaktere, Waffen und anderer Gameplay-Features wie Autofahren und Gabelstapler.

PAYDAY 2 é um jogo FPS de ação cooperativo de quatro jogadores que permite os jogadores a jogar na pele da gangue PAYDAY original - Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf e Chains - enquanto vão para Washington DC para uma épica série de crimes.
 
 A rede CRIMENET oferece um alcance enorme de contratos dinâmicos, e jogadores são livres para escolher tudo, desde uma pequena loja de conveniencia para roubar ou sequestrar alguem, até participar da grande liga do cyber-crime ou limpar o cofre inteiro de um grande banco, tudo para se ter pilhas de dinheiro. Enquanto em DC, por que não participar da comunidade local, e fazer alguns trabalhos políticos?
 
 Junte-se com mais três amigos para realizar os golpes, e quanto mais a equipe progride, os trabalhos se tornam maiores, melhores e com mais recompensas. Conforme você vai ganhando mais dinheiro e se tornando cada vez mais um criminoso lendário, vem a costumização de personagem e o sistema de elaboração que permite as equipes costumizarem suas armas e equipamentos. Elementos Principais   Roube Bancos, Seja Pago – Jogadores devem escolher sua equipe com calma, porque quando o trabalho começa, eles precisam ter a combinação certa de habilidades ao seu lado.
   CRIMENET – O dinâmico banco de dados de contratos permite os jogadores pegar e escolher os trabalhos disponíveis conectando-os com contatos locais como Vlad, o Ucraniano, o politico sombrio "O Elefante", e um traficante de drogas da Améica de Sul Hector, todos com sua própria agenda e com seus interesses em mente.
   Tiroteios do PAYDAY e Mecânicas em um Novo Nível – Atirar com armas e amarrar cíveis nunca foi tão bom.
   Cenários Dinâmicos – Nenhum golpe é igual quando jogado pela segunda vez. Cada cenário tem uma geometria aleatória ou até eventos raros.
   Escolha Suas Habilidades – Conforme os jogadores avançam, eles podem investir em cinco Árvores de Habilidades especiais: Mestre, Executor, Técnico, Fantasma e Fugitivo. Cada uma apresenta uma profunda costumização associado à habilidades e equipamentos, e eles podem ser misturados para formar o assaltante perfeito.
   Mais Máscaras do que Nunca – PAYDAY 2 apresenta um novo sistema de máscaras, dando a oportunidade de jogadores criarem suas próprias máscaras únicas com diferentes modelos e cores para escolher, resultando em milhões de combinações diferentes.
   Armas e Modificações – Um grande novo arsenal para um assaltante sério, cobrindo tudo, desde Rifles de Precisão e Assalto até compactas PDW's e SMG's. Uma vez que escolheu sua favorita, você pode modificar a arma com miras, silenciadores, empunhadeiras, lunetas, canos, coronhas e mais. Também se tem melhorias puramente estéticas - por que não ir parecendo o rei das drogas com sua empunhadeira polida na sua arma.
   Jogue do Seu Jeito – Cada trabalho permite mutiplas aproximações, como ir devagar e fazer emboscadas furtivas ou sair correndo e atirando. Cheque no objetivo da sua maneira, cada aproximação trará uma experiência diferente.
   Uma Longa História de Conteúdo Adicional – Mais de 70 atualizações lançadas, incluindo novos golpes, personagens, armas e outras novidades na jogabilidades, como dirigir carros ou empilhadeiras.

PAYDAY 2はアクション満載の4人プレイ可能なCO-OPシューターです。前作同様、プレイヤーはマスクを被りPAYDAYクルーのダラス、ホクストン、ウルフ、チェインズに扮してワシントンDCで強盗街道をひた走ります。
 
 CRIMENETのネットワークは無数の契約者と貴方を引き合わせ、プレイヤーはその中からPAYDAYの為に単純なコンビニ強盗から誘拐、サイバー犯罪や大手銀行強盗に至るまで、好きな仕事を選択する事が出来ます。DCに居る間、地域社会に貢献するつもりで、政治にも影響を及ぼしてみませんか？
 
 最大4人の友人とCo-OPで強盗を行い、クルーが進歩する程、より大きな仕事と報酬を得ることが出来るでしょう。大金を得て、伝説級の犯罪者になるだけではなく、クルーが自らの銃や装備をカスタマイズするためのクラフトシステムも導入されています。 ゲームの特徴   銀行強盗を行い、報酬を得る – プレイヤーはクルーを慎重に選ぶ必要があります。プレイヤーは仕事が進むにつれ、特定のスキルが必要になっていく事に気付くでしょう。
   CRIMENET – ダイナミックな契約者データベースにより、プレイヤーはその地区で活動している契約者と契約を結ぶことが出来ます。例えばウクライナ人のヴラド、裏の顔がある政治家「エレファント」、南アメリカの麻薬密売人であるヘクター等がそれぞれ自らの目的の達成の為に凌ぎを削っています。 
   進化したPAYDAYの重火器システムと仕様 – 銃を発砲する事と、市民を拘束する事が今まで以上に気持ちのいい体験に。
   ダイナミックなシナリオ – ハイストは常に新鮮な体験になり、同じハイストであっても、違った地形やイベントに巡り合う事になるでしょう。
   スキルを選択する – プレイヤーが上達していくと共に、プレイヤーは5つのスキルから役職を選択する事が出来ます：マスターマインド、エンフォーサー、ゴースト、テクニシャンとフュージティブです。それぞれのスキルは多様なカスタマイズが可能で、用途や装備によって取得できるうえに、ばらばらのスキルを混ぜ合わせる事で最強のハイスターを作り上げる事が出来るでしょう。
   最大のマスク量 – PAYDAY 2は完全に新しいマスクシステムを導入し、パターンやカラーを選ぶことで多様なコンビネーションを可能にしており、全てのプレイヤーが自分専用の独自なマスクを作り上げる事が出来るでしょう。
   武器と改造 – 多数の武器が追加されており、それらはスナイパーやアサルトライフルからコンパクトPDWやSMGに至るまで幅広いジャンルをカバーしています。自分の好みの武器が見つかったら、照準器、サプレッサー、フォアグリップ、レティクル、バレル、フレーム、ストック等々、と無数の改造が可能です。これらは全てが武器のパフォーマンスに影響します。また、その中には単純に外装を変えるだけの用途の物も存在します。仕事に行くのであれば、最高の外装を施した武器は如何でしょうか？
   自分流に遊べ – それぞれのジョブは無数のアプローチが可能です。例えば静かにステルスで侵入する方法もあれば、武器を発砲しながら突っ走る方法もあるでしょう。自分が好きな方法で遊んでみてください、それぞれのアプローチは違った体験を生むことでしょう。
   長い追加コンテンツの歴史 – リリースから既に70以上のアップデートをしてきました。新たなハイスト、キャラクター、武器の追加だけではなく、フォークリフトや車の運転という新しいゲームプレイも追加し、常に進化し続けています。

PAYDAY 2 is an action-packed, four-player co-op shooter that once again lets gamers don the masks of the original PAYDAY crew - Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf and Chains - as they descend on Washington DC for an epic crime spree. 
 
 The CRIMENET network offers a huge range of dynamic contracts, and players are free to choose anything from small-time convenience store hits or kidnappings, to big league cyber-crime or emptying out major bank vaults for that epic PAYDAY. While in DC, why not participate in the local community, and run a few political errands?
 
 Up to four friends co-operate on the hits, and as the crew progresses the jobs become bigger, better and more rewarding. Along with earning more money and becoming a legendary criminal comes a character customization and crafting system that lets crews build and customize their own guns and gear. Key Features   Rob Banks, Get Paid – Players must choose their crew carefully, because when the job goes down they will need the right mix of skills on their side.
   CRIMENET – The dynamic contract database lets gamers pick and choose from available jobs by connecting with local contacts such as Vlad the Ukrainian, shady politician "The Elephant", and South American drug trafficker Hector, all with their own agenda and best interests in mind.
   PAYDAY Gunplay and Mechanics on a New Level – Firing weapons and zip tying civilians never felt so good.
   Dynamic Scenarios – No heist ever plays out the same way twice. Every single scenario has random geometry or even rare events.
   Choose Your Skills – As players progress they can invest in any of five special Skill Trees: Mastermind, Enforcer, Ghost, Technician and Fugitive. Each features a deep customization tree of associated skills and equipment to master, and they can be mixed and matched to create the ultimate heister.
   More Masks than Ever – PAYDAY 2 features a completely new mask system, giving players the ability to craft their own unique mask with a pattern and color of their choice, resulting in millions of different combinations.  
   Weapons and Modifications – A brand new arsenal for the serious heister, covering everything from sniper and assault rifles to compact PDWs and SMGs. Once you've settled for a favorite, you can modify it with optics, suppressors, fore grips, reticles, barrels, frames, stocks and more, all of which will affect the performance of your weapon. There are also purely aesthetic enhancements - why not go for the drug lord look with polished walnut grips for your nine?
   Play It Your Way – Each job allows for multiple approaches, such as slow and stealthy ambushes or running in guns blazing. Hit the target any way you want, each approach will provide a different experience.
   A Long History of Additional Content – More than 70 updates since release, including new heists, characters, weapons and other gameplay features like driving cars and forklifts.

PAYDAY 2 è uno sparatutto cooperativo d'azione che permette a 4 giocatori di indossare i panni della famigerata Banda Payday, formata da Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf e Chains, e commettere rapine per tutta Washington DC. 
 
 CRIMENET è un network che offre un'ampia gamma di contratti dinamici. I giocatori sono liberi di scegliere qualsiasi tipo di contratto: da piccole rapine a negozi o sequestri di persona, da cyber-crimini su larga scala a rapine alle più grandi banche del paese. Perché non aiutare la comunità e svolgere qualche lavoretto a sfondo politico mentre si è a Washington?
 
 Fino a quattro amici possono partecipare ad un colpo e man mano che la squadra fa progressi i contratti diventeranno più ambiziosi e remunerativi. Oltre che a diventare un criminale leggendario, PAYDAY 2 offre la possibilità alla squadra di migliorare e personalizzare il proprio arsenale ed equipaggiamento. Caratteristiche di PAYDAY 2 
   PAYDAY 2 è uno sparatutto cooperativo d'azione che permette a 4 giocatori di indossare i panni della famigerata Banda Payday e commettere rapine per tutta Washington DC.
   Rapina banche e diventa ricco - I giocatori dovranno scegliere con attenzione la propria squadra perché una volta che cominceranno la rapina potranno contare solo sulle loro abilità e sui compagni di squadra.
   CRIMENET - Il database dinamico per i contratti permette ai giocatori di scegliere uno tra i contratti disponibili offerti dai contatti locali come Vlad l'Ucraino, il politico corrotto "L'Elefante", e il trafficante di droga Sud Americano Hector. Ognuno con i loro obiettivi ed interessi.
   Meccaniche completamente rinnovate - Sparare con la propria arma ed ammanettare i civili non è mai stato così soddisfacente.
   Scenari dinamici - Ogni colpo può essere rigiocato più e più volte. Ogni contratto ha eventi casuali (di cui alcuni anche molto rari) che permettono di avere scenari sempre diversi ad ogni partita.
   Scegli le tue abilità - Mentre i giocatori salgono di livello potranno investire in uno dei 5 alberi di abilità disponibili: Manipolatore, Specialista, Tecnico, Spettro e Fuggitivo. Ognuno contiene altri alberi di abilità che consentono di personalizzare il proprio equipaggiamento, oltre a poter essere combinati tra di loro per creare il rapinatore definitivo.
   Ancora più maschere! - PAYDAY 2 presenta un nuovo sistema di personalizzazione delle maschere che dà l'abilità ai giocatori di realizzare la loro maschera dei sogni grazie all'ampia scelta di motivi e colori.
   Armi e modifiche - Un arsenale degno dei migliori rapinatori. C'è di tutto: dai fucili da cecchino ai fucili d'assalto, dalle mitragliatrici alle pistole. Una volta che avrai trovato la tua arma preferita modificala con ottiche, soppressori, impugnature, reticoli, canne, calci e molto altro. Ogni modifica inoltre influenzerà le statistiche della tua arma. Ci sono anche delle modifiche puramente cosmetiche così da poter sfoggiare il tuo stile anche sulle tue armi!
   Gioca a modo tuo - Ogni contratto permette approcci multipli, ad esempio si può essere cauti e silenziosi oppure entrare ad armi spianate. Esegui la missione come meglio credi: ogni approccio porterà ad un'esperienza diversa.
   Una lunga storia di contenuti aggiuntivi - Più di 70 aggiornamenti dal rilascio che hanno aggiunto nuovi contratti, personaggi ed armi oltre che a nuove meccaniche come macchine e muletti guidabili.

game.title: Whisper of the House
game.description: What's happening in this seemingly peaceful town? Strange residents, bizarre incidents, and unexpected storylines! Please be sure to let go of all your human lifestyle preferences and strive to meet the special requests of your otherworldly employers. Decorate this house with peculiar furniture!

game.title: The Binding of Isaac
game.description:
The Binding of Isaac is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac's form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover secrets and fight his way to safety.

The Binding of Isaac‍ '​s plot is loosely inspired by the biblical story of the same name. Isaac, a child, and his mother live in a small house on a hill, both happily keeping to themselves, with Isaac drawing pictures and playing with his toys, and his mother watching Christian broadcasts on television. Isaac's mother then hears "a voice from above", stating her son is corrupted with sin, and needs to be saved. It asks her to remove all that was evil from Isaac, in an attempt to save him. His mother obliges, taking away his toys, drawings, and even his clothes.

The voice once again speaks to Isaac's mother, stating that Isaac must be cut off from all that is evil in the world. Once again, his mother obliges, and locks Isaac inside his room. Once more, the voice speaks to Isaac's mother. It states she has done well, but it still questions her devotion, and requests she sacrifice her son. She obliges, grabbing a butcher's knife from the kitchen and walking to Isaac's room. Isaac, watching through a sizable crack in his door, starts to panic. He finds a trapdoor hidden under his rug and jumps in, just before his mother opens his bedroom door. Isaac then puts the paper he was drawing onto his wall, which becomes the title screen.

During the game's loading points, Isaac is shown curled up in a ball, crying. His thoughts are visible, ranging among rejection from his mother and humiliation from his peers to a scenario involving his own death. The game features 13 endings, one after each major boss fight.

Isaac's mother then hears "a voice from above", stating her son is corrupted with sin, and needs to be saved. It asks her to remove all that was evil from Isaac, in an attempt to save him. His mother obliges, taking away his toys, drawings, and even his clothes.

The voice once again speaks to Isaac's mother, stating that Isaac must be cut off from all that is evil in the world. Once again, his mother obliges, and locks Isaac inside his room. Once more, the voice speaks to Isaac's mother. It states she has done well, but it still questions her devotion, and requests she sacrifice her son. She obliges, grabbing a butcher's knife from the kitchen and walking to Isaac's room. Isaac, watching through a sizable crack in his door, starts to panic. He finds a trapdoor hidden under his rug and jumps in, just before his mother opens his bedroom door. Isaac then puts the paper he was drawing onto his wall, which becomes the title screen.

During the game's loading points, Isaac is shown curled up in a ball, crying. His thoughts are visible, ranging among rejection from his mother and humiliation from his peers to a scenario involving his own death. The game features 13 endings, one after each major boss fight.

You will face other civilizations, either online as other people or played by the computer, civilization 5 features a advanced diplomacy system when dealing with computer controlled civs or computer controlled city-states.

game.title: Shadowverse CCG
game.description:
Four million battles every day. One Shadowverse. Japan's #1 strategic card game.
 
Made by card gamers for card gamers. 
 

 
Shadowverse is Japan's #1 strategic card game!
 
- There are millions of Shadowverse battles every day, and a multitude of ways to play
 
- Easy to get into, thanks to a singleplayer story mode, free card packs for new players, and bonuses every day 
 
- Battles are finely balanced, with less RNG than other card games, and balance adjustments take place every month
 
- New card expansions are released every three months, unleashing new deck-building strategies and battle tactics
 
- We’ve got a great community of 22 million players and counting, with tournaments and esports broadcasts every week and support for streamers 
 
- Featuring beautiful art and animations and fully voiced cards and story
 

 

 
- A multitude of ways to play: 
 
With eight different leader classes, Shadowverse gives you unparalleled freedom to create your own deck strategies. Will you play as Urias and unleash your Vengeance when your health is depleted? Or will you select Isabelle, whose spells power up the cards in your hand? Will you go all in with an aggro deck, or try to contain the board with a control deck? Or will you try to sneak in some sublimely ingenious combos? It’s entirely up to you. 
 

 
- Easy to get into: 
 
Learn the basics by playing through our extensive singleplayer story mode before taking on other players in our multiplayer modes. Be sure to pick up your free card packs after you’ve finished playing through the tutorial – just go to your Crate from the main menu to pick them up. And bonuses and daily missions help you unlock new card packs every day so it won’t be long before you have a deck that is capable of competing with the very best. 
 

 
- Finely balanced: 
 
There’s less RNG in Shadowverse than other card games, making it supremely balanced: you’ll need to trust your judgement not your luck if you are to come out on top. And we make balance adjustments every month to make sure that no one card or deck type becomes too dominant.
 

 
- New card expansions released regularly: 
 
New card expansions are added every three months to make sure the meta never gets stale. And every single expansion unleashes new deck-building strategies and battle tactics, and even new leader classes and game modes. We’re in this for the long haul and we hope you will be too.
 

 
- Beautiful art:
 
All of the cards in Shadowverse feature fantastic art by some of Japan’s finest artists, and every single card is available as an animated version. Every card is also fully-voiced, in English and Japanese, as is the singleplayer storyline. 
 

 
- A great community:
 
And last but not least, we have some amazing fans. We’ve got memes, we’ve got streams, and we have much, much more to offer than the average card game. Community tournaments and e-sports broadcasts take place every week, and there are a ton of deck-building resources online in case you get stuck. Millions of card gamers can’t be wrong – why don’t you join them?

And last but not least, we have some amazing fans. We’ve got memes, we’ve got streams, and we have much, much more to offer than the average card game. Community tournaments and e-sports broadcasts take place every week, and there are a ton of deck-building resources online in case you get stuck. Millions of card gamers can’t be wrong – why don’t you join them?

game.description:
Astral Ascent is a 2D platformer roguelite game set in a modern fantasy world. As one of 4 Heroes with very different personalities, you must escape from The Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful and vicious bosses, the Zodiacs.  

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE        
 Unlock dozens of unique spells for each or your characters. Optimize your own build or try out new ones to face all the challenges you'll find on your journey for freedom. Get progressively stronger with time to match up with your foes. Each run will test your skills and your reactivity. 

 TWELVE ALMIGHTY BOSSES TO FACE        
The Zodiacs are 12 experienced guardians dispatched over 4 gorgeous worlds. Each with their own unique attacks and combat styles, backstories to uncover and reasons to be fighting you, they'll pose as a big threat to anyone seeking a way out of the Garden . Get yourself warned!  

4 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS     
  Unique characters. Unique weapons. Unique ways to play. 
 
• Ayla: A skilled assassin sent on a mission by her guild to prove her worth, she uses her sharp blades to eliminate targets before they can react. Her speed and proficiency are unmatched.

• Kiran: An orphan that has learned life the hard way. He uses his raw strength to deliver attacks powerful enough to create shockwaves. Brutal.

• Calie: This talented sculptor became a warrior to recover the freedom her people have lost. She will use her magical gemstones to pierce enemy defenses and shred them to bits. She is unforgiving.

• Octave: Trained by a powerful witch, this young fighter summons ethereal weapons to attack his foes. Big or small, short or long range, he has the right one for every occasion. Lethal in all cases.   

 A STORY THAT OPENS UP, ONE PIECE AT A TIME     
 Astral Ascent is a roguelite infused with narration. Replayability is part of a story that will be unraveled piece by piece. As you get stronger, you will discover more about the characters, their motivations and the secrets of the world they’re trapped in. 

 LOCAL CO-OP        
 The weight of destiny is too heavy to carry by yourself? Don’t worry and bring a friend to play with the  two-player co-op  mode. Fight and crush your enemies together in local co-op or online using the Steam's Remote Play Together feature.  

A VAST, COLORFUL FANTASY WORLD WAITING TO BE EXPLORED        
 Dash across gigantic landscapes. Explore original and hand-crafted areas. Discover a fantastic universe loaded with gorgeous art and fluid frame-by-frame animation.

《星界战士》（原名：星座上升）是一款以现代幻想世界为背景的2D平台rogue-lite游戏。作为4个性格迥异的英雄之一，你必须设法从 花园 逃离，这个大花园是一座由12个强大且邪恶的boss守护的星界监狱，另称“十二星宫”。  勇往直前        
 为你的4个不同角色解锁数十个独特的法术。优化你的构建或尝试一个新的方式试图击败12个强大的boss。随着时间的推进你会变得更强，拥有匹配与敌人抗衡的实力。每次跑关都将测试你的技能和反应能力。  好友合作        
 命运的重担想找人一起扛？这个可以有，欢迎邀请好友一起体验我们的 双人合作 模式。通过本地合作或使用    Steam在线远程同乐功能 ，和朋友联手把敌人按在地上摩擦吧！  星体威胁        
 “十二星宫”是由被派往4个华丽世界的12名经验丰富的守护者所看护。他们将在战场上展示独有的攻击，能力和模式，同时揭露战斗背后的故事，让你知道对你展开攻击的原因。接受挑战警告吧！  重玩价值  
 《星座上升》是一款融入叙述的rogue-lite游戏。重玩性是我们故事的一部分，在重复体验中将故事逐步揭开。当你变得更强大，你会发现更多关于角色，动机，以及他们所困世界的秘密。  优美的现代幻想世界  在广阔的风景中穿梭。探索原始和手工制作的领域。通过华丽的艺术和逐帧动画，探索我们的艺术家创造的世界。  4个游戏角色     
  独特的角色。独特的武器。独特的游戏方式。  
    Ayla:  作为其所属刺客公会唯一的幸存者，她能挥舞双刀在敌人做出反应之前就消灭他们。其速度和精巧是无与伦比的。 
    Kiran:  这名孤儿在逆境中体验生活。他可利用自己的力量发动足以产生冲击波的攻击。足够残忍。 
    Calie:  这位才华横溢的雕刻家想要重获自由。她将使用她的魔法宝石刺穿敌人的防御并粉碎他们。冷酷无情。 
    Octave:  在一位强大女巫的训练下，这位年轻的战士能召唤空灵的武器来攻击他的敌人。在需要的时候，他也可以召唤更强大的武器。招招致命。     希望之光：结盟    你可以依靠忠诚的盟友帮你找到出路  
    The Merchant:  这个神秘的人物有能力通过回忆遗忘技能展示你真正的潜能。小心点，这是要付出代价的。 
    Zim-Zim:  她的温室里藏着可以增加你能力的神奇植物。当然，前提是你能忍受她异想天开和不那么成熟的行为。
    Oloon:  全世界最好的造型师就在这里，随时待命。想改变衣服的颜色吗? 想给头发染个新的颜色? 她能满足你一切需求! 
    Papa Yalee:  这只老家伙——快20岁了! - 它能持续分享关于你将遇到的敌人和你跑关的故事。 好消息是……大部分内容都是真实的。 
    Sova:  Sova曾经是一个强大的女巫，后来由于遭受了诅咒，现在她必须服务于这个大花园。她的过去一直是在默默承受耻辱。
    Ordan: 作为花园 实际 的领导者，这位勇猛的战士帮助英雄们完成任务。她拥有传奇的力量。 
    Ikki:  他是Ordan的前夫，也是一名强大的战士，负责英雄们的训练。拥有无尽的兵法知识。
