Astral Ascent es un juego roguelite de plataformas en 2D ambientado en un mundo de fantasía moderna. Controlando a uno de 4 protagonistas con personalidades muy marcadas, deberás escapar del Jardín, una prisión astral custodiada por 12 jefes poderosos y sanguinarios: los Zodiacos.  

CREA TU PROPIO ESTILO DE JUEGO        
 Desbloquea decenas de hechizos únicos para tus protagonistas. Optimiza tus configuraciones o prueba otras nuevas para enfrentarte a todos los retos que encontrarás a lo largo de tu camino hacia la libertad. Hazte más fuerte a medida que juegues para estar a la altura de tus rivales. Cada partida pondrá a prueba tu destreza y reflejos.  

DOCE JEFES SUMAMENTE PODEROSOS        
 Los Zodiacos son 12 guardianes expertos que custodian cuatro hermosos mundos. Cada Zodiaco tiene ataques y estilos de combate únicos, una historia y motivos por los que se enfrentan a ti que tendrás que descubrir. Son una amenaza para todo aquel que pretenda escapar del Jardín. ¡Quien avisa, no es traidor!  

CUATRO PERSONAJES JUGABLES     
  Personajes únicos. Armas únicas. Formas de jugar únicas. 
    
• Ayla: una hábil asesina que debe demostrar su valía ante su gremio de asesinos. Con sus dagas elimina a sus enemigos antes de darles tiempo a reaccionar. Su agilidad y destreza no tienen rival.
    
• Kiran: un huérfano que aprendió lo dura que es la vida por las bravas. Con su fuerza bruta lanza ataques tan potentes como para crear ondas expansivas. Brutal.
    
• Calie: una escultora de gran talento que se convirtió en guerrera para recuperar la libertad que perdió su pueblo. Utilizará sus gemas mágicas para penetrar en las defensas enemigas y hacerlas pedazos. Es implacable.
   
• Octave: adiestrado por una poderosa bruja, este joven guerrero invoca armas etéreas con las que puede atacar a sus enemigos: grandes, pequeñas, de corto o largo alcance, pero siempre tiene un arma ideal para cada ocasión. Siempre es letal.    

UNA HISTORIA REVELADA POCO A POCO     
 Astral Ascent es un roguelite repleto de narrativa. La rejugabilidad forma parte de una historia que se irá desvelando poco a poco. A medida que te vayas haciendo más fuerte, profundizarás en la historia de los personajes, sus motivos y los secretos del mundo en el que están atrapados.  

COOPERATIVO LOCAL        
 ¿Piensas que el destino es una carga demasiado pesada? ¡No te preocupes y tráete a un colega para jugar en nuestro modo  cooperativo para dos jugadores ! Luchad y aplastad juntos a vuestros enemigos de forma local o en línea con el sistema Remote Play Together de Steam.  

UN MUNDO DE FANTASÍA EXTENSO Y PINTORESCO A EXPLORAR        
 Recorre paisajes gigantescos. Explora espacios originales y dibujados a mano. Descubre un universo fantástico repleto de ilustraciones magníficas y animaciones de lo más fluidas.

Astral Ascent est un jeu de plate-forme rogue-lite 2D basé sur un univers fantastique moderne et original. Aux commandes d’un des 4 héros et héroïnes aux personnalités et gameplays variés, vous devez vous enfuir du Jardin, une prison astrale gardée par les Zodiaques, 12 boss puissants et vicieux. 

 COMBATTEZ À VOTRE FAÇON        
 Débloquer des douzaines de sorts uniques pour 4 personnages distincts. Optimisez votre build ou essayez de nouvelles combinaisons pour affronter les 12 boss redoutables. Devenez plus fort pour égaliser vos chances contre vos adversaires. Chaque run mettra vos talents et votre réactivité à rude épreuve.  

UNE MENACE ASTRALE        
 Les Zodiaques sont 12 gardiens expérimentés dispersés sur 4 mondes magnifiques. Chacun possède des attaques et des compétences uniques à découvrir lors des combats… mais ils ont aussi leur propre histoire et leur propre raison de vous affronter. Soyez sur vos gardes !  

4 PERSONNAGES JOUABLES     
  Personnages uniques. Armes uniques. Gameplays uniques. 
   
• Ayla : La seule survivante d’une guilde d’assassines, elle utilise ses doubles dagues  pour éliminer en un éclair ses ennemis. Sa vitesse et son habilité sont imbattables.
  
 • Kiran : Cet orphelin a grandi à la dure et ça se voit. Il utilise sa force pure pour infliger de puissants dégâts et les répliques de ses coups blessent les ennemis autour. Brutal.
   
• Calie : Cette sculptrice de génie veut retrouver sa liberté à tout prix. Elle fait tournoyer des gemmes autour d’elle pour annihiler les défenses ennemies et imposer ses idées.
  
• Octave : Entraîné par sa sœur, une sorcière surpuissante, ce jeune combattant invoque auprès de lui des armes éthérées pour attaquer ses ennemis. Si nécessaire, il fait appel à de l’artillerie lourde. Mortel, dans tous les sens du terme.    

UNE HISTOIRE À JOUER… ET À REJOUER     
 Astral Ascent est un rogue-lite imprégné de narration. La rejouabilité fait partie de notre histoire qui se dévoile petit à petit. À mesure que vous devenez plus fort, vous lèverez le voile sur les personnages, leurs motivations, et les nombreux secrets du monde coloré du Jardin.  

JAMAIS SEUL !        
 Le poids de votre destin est trop lourd pour vos épaules ? Pas d’inquiétude : emmenez un ami avec vous dans notre mode coop pour 2 joueurs. Affrontez et anéantissez vos ennemis en coop local ou bien en ligne en utilisant le Remote Play Together de Steam.  

UN MONDE MAGNIFIQUE, MÊLANT FANTASY ET SCIENCE-FICTION        
 Élancez-vous à travers d’immenses paysages à couper le souffle. Explorer des lieux originaux dans une magnifique 2D faite main. Découvrez un monde construit avec précision et amour par nos artistes, depuis le pixel art jusqu’à des cinématiques en dessin traditionnel.

Astral Ascent é um roguelite de plataforma 2D ambientado em um mundo de fantasia moderna. Na pele de 4 Heróis distintos, você deve escapar do Jardim, uma prisão astral guardada por 12 poderosos e cruéis chefes, os Zodíacos.  

CRIE SEU PRÓPRIO ESTILO DE JOGO        
 Desbloqueie dezenas de magias únicas para cada um dos seus personagens. Otimize sua build ou experimente novas estratégias para enfrentar todos os desafios que surgirão no seu caminho em busca pela liberdade. Fortaleça-se progressivamente para bater de frente com os seus inimigos. Cada run testará as suas habilidades e a sua reatividade.  

DOZE PODEROSOS CHEFES PARA ENFRENTAR        
 Os Zodíacos são 12 guardiões experientes espalhados entre 4 mundos deslumbrantes. Cada um com os seus próprios ataques, estilos de combate, histórias para descobrir e razões para lutar contra você, eles serão uma ameaça constante a todos aqueles que desejarem escapar. Esteja preparado! 

 4 PERSONAGENS JOGÁVEIS     
  Personagens únicos. Armas únicas. Maneiras únicas de jogar. 
  
• Ayla: Uma habilidosa assassina enviada em uma missão para provar o seu valor, ela usa suas lâminas gêmeas para eliminar alvos antes que eles possam reagir. Sua velocidade e proficiência são incomparáveis.

• Kiran: Um órfão aprendeu as coisas da vida da maneira mais difícil. Ele usa sua força para desferir ataques poderosos o suficiente para criar ondas de impacto. Brutal.

• Calie:  Uma talentosa escultora que se tornou uma guerreira para reconquistar a liberdade do seu povo. Ela usará seus cristais mágicos para perfurar as defesas inimigas e e transformá-las em pedaços. Ela não perdoa ninguém no seu caminho.

• Octave:  Treinado por uma poderosa bruxa, este jovem lutador conjura armas etéreas para atacar seus inimigos. Seja de grande ou pequeno porte, de curto ou longo alcance, ele possui a arma certa para cada ocasião. Letal em todos os casos.   

UMA HISTÓRIA QUE SE DESDOBRA, UMA PEÇA DE CADA VEZ     
 Astral Ascent é um roguelite repleto de narrativa. A rejogabilidade faz parte da história, que será desvendada peça por peça. Conforme você fica mais forte, mais coisas irá descobrir sobre cada um dos personagens, suas motivações e os segredos do mundo em que estão presos.  

CO-OP LOCAL        
 O peso do destino é muito pesado para carregar sozinho? Não se preocupe e traga um amigo para jogar com você no modo co-op para dois jogadores. Lute e derrote seus inimigos no co-op local ou online usando o recurso Remote Play Together do Steam.

UM VASTO  E COLORIDO MUNDO DE FANTASIA PRONTO PARA SER EXPLORADO        
 Corra por paisagens gigantescas. Explore áreas ricas em detalhes desenhados à mão. Descubra um universo fantástico repleto de uma arte deslumbrante e animações quadro a quadro.

『アストラルアセント』は、ファンタジーな世界を舞台とした２Ｄローグライク・アクションアドベンチャーゲームです。４人のキャラクターから主人公を選び、強大な12体の守護者「ゾディアック」に守られた境界の監獄「ガーデン」を攻略していきます。  意志を貫け  個性的な４人のキャラクターと、数十種類のスペルをアンロックしよう！自分に合ったビルドを見つけ試していこう！そして、どんどん強くなって、ボスへ立ち向かおう！行動一つ一つに、あなたの反応とスキルが試されている。  １人じゃない  宿命を１人で背負うのは重すぎる･･。そんな時は 「２人協力」  モードでフレンドと一緒にプレイしよう！Steamの REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER を使って、ローカル協力プレイや、オンラインで一緒に敵に立ち向かおう！  アストラルの脅威  気を付けて！「ゾディアック」は、華やかな４つのフィールドに位置する強大な12体の守護者です。彼らは、特殊な攻撃、能力、パターンを駆使し、キャラクター達と戦う真の理由を持ってくる！  リプレイ性を通じた物語  『アストラルアセント』は、リプレイ性が高いローグライクゲームです！プレイヤーが成長することで、物語はすこしずつ紐解かれ、キャラクターとその動機や、彼らが閉じ込められている世界の真相を見つけよう！  美しいモダンファンタジーの世界  巨大な風景を駆け抜けよう！繊細な手作り感あるステージを探索しよう！豪華なアート、フレーム単位のアニメーション、アーティストたちが創り出した世界を冒険しよう！  4人のキャラクター     
  個性的なキャラクターと武器、遊び方 
    アイラ：  彼女はアサシンギルドの唯一の生き残り。ツインダガーを使って、気づかれる前に敵を排除する。そのスピードと精度は、他の追随を許さない。
    カイラン：  苦難な生涯を生き抜いた孤児。そこに宿る強靭な心は、衝撃波が出るほどの、強力かつ残忍な攻撃を繰り出す。
    キャリー：  誰よりも自由を求める彫刻家。彼女の攻撃は容赦がなく、魔石を使って敵を貫き、粉砕する。
    オクターヴ：  屈強な魔女に鍛えられた若きファイター。エーテルのような銃を召喚し敵を攻撃する。必要に応じて強大な武器を呼び起こし、すべてに致命傷を負わせる。    希望の同盟   ゴールを目指すうえで、信頼のおける同盟を頼ろう。 
    謎の商人：  この謎の人物は、失われた技術を復旧し、あなたの真の可能性を引き出せる。但し･･それには代償が伴う。
    ヂムヂム：  彼女の温室では、あなたの能力を高める魔法植物が隠されてます。彼女の気まぐれで稚拙な行動に、耐えられるかどうか。
    オルーン：  宇宙一のスタイリストがここにいて、利用できる。服の色を変えたい？髪を染めたい？必要なものは何でもそろってる！
    パパ・ヤリー：  もうすぐ20歳になるこの老猫は、あなたが遭遇するであろう敵や、あなたが走る先について、いつも良い話をするだろう。
    ソヴァ：  かつて強力な魔術師だった彼女は呪われてしまい、今はガーデンに仕えなければならなかった。彼女は過去を「恥」思い、沈黙を続けている。
    オルダン：   ガーデンの実質リーダー  であり、この勇敢な戦士は、英雄探しを助けている。彼女の力は伝説となっている。
    イッキ：  オルダンの元夫であり、強力な戦士の一人である彼は、英雄たちの育成を担当している。彼の戦争術の知識は尽きない。

game.brief:
Astral Ascent is a 2D platformer roguelite game set in a modern fantasy world. As one of 4 Heroes with very different personalities, you must escape from The Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful and vicious bosses, the Zodiacs.  

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE        
 Unlock dozens of unique spells for each or your characters. Optimize your own build or try out new ones to face all the challenges you'll find on your journey for freedom. Get progressively stronger with time to match up with your foes. Each run will test your skills and your reactivity. 

 TWELVE ALMIGHTY BOSSES TO FACE        
The Zodiacs are 12 experienced guardians dispatched over 4 gorgeous worlds. Each with their own unique attacks and combat styles, backstories to uncover and reasons to be fighting you, they'll pose as a big threat to anyone seeking a way out of the Garden . Get yourself warned!  

4 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS     
  Unique characters. Unique weapons. Unique ways to play. 
 
• Ayla: A skilled assassin sent on a mission by her guild to prove her worth, she uses her sharp blades to eliminate targets before they can react. Her speed and proficiency are unmatched.

• Kiran: An orphan that has learned life the hard way. He uses his raw strength to deliver attacks powerful enough to create shockwaves. Brutal.

• Calie: This talented sculptor became a warrior to recover the freedom her people have lost. She will use her magical gemstones to pierce enemy defenses and shred them to bits. She is unforgiving.

• Octave: Trained by a powerful witch, this young fighter summons ethereal weapons to attack his foes. Big or small, short or long range, he has the right one for every occasion. Lethal in all cases.   

 A STORY THAT OPENS UP, ONE PIECE AT A TIME     
 Astral Ascent is a roguelite infused with narration. Replayability is part of a story that will be unraveled piece by piece. As you get stronger, you will discover more about the characters, their motivations and the secrets of the world they’re trapped in. 

 LOCAL CO-OP        
 The weight of destiny is too heavy to carry by yourself? Don’t worry and bring a friend to play with the  two-player co-op  mode. Fight and crush your enemies together in local co-op or online using the Steam's Remote Play Together feature.  

A VAST, COLORFUL FANTASY WORLD WAITING TO BE EXPLORED        
 Dash across gigantic landscapes. Explore original and hand-crafted areas. Discover a fantastic universe loaded with gorgeous art and fluid frame-by-frame animation.

game.title: Tails of Iron
game.description:
Bright Fir Forest - Free Expansion        
  
  Tails of Iron  now includes ‘ Bright Fir Forest ’, a second free expansion that continues Redgi’s regal journey. Featuring 13 new quests (four story quests and nine side quests) this end-game expansion takes the young Rat King to the Squirrels’ renowned Festival of Leaf Fall, adds three new challengers in the Mole Arena, further broadens character customisation with new weapons and armour, includes eight cosmetic upgrades for the Crimson Keep, and more.
  
 King of Frogkind, the maniacal  Greenwart  has been vanquished, but despite the joyous celebrations in the forest, a new amphibious menace may be about to bubble through the pond scum… can Redgi overcome the emerging threat and be back in time to enjoy an acorn cup of Bright Sap under the luscious green canopies of Bright Fir?
  
 Your tail continues…
 
  Bloody Whiskers - Free Expansion        
 
  Tails of Iron  now includes ‘ Bloody Whiskers ’: a free expansion which introduces a new post-game questline, two additional difficulty modes, five new bosses, a selection of special armours and weapons, and a secret that was perhaps better left forgotten…
 
 With the tyrannical  Greenwart  now defeated, King  Redgi’s  vast lands chime with celebration. But the recently crowned saviour isn’t free to rest easy on his throne just yet. As decreed by an ancient Rat tradition, the new King must prove his worth… in a deadly trial of combat.
 
 Defeat the most lethal warriors from across the land to claim the key to the old King’s room. But what heinous secret lurks within?
 
 Your tail continues…
 
  About the Game    
 
 Set in a grim land plagued by war, Tails of Iron is a hand-drawn RPG Adventure with punishingly brutal combat. As Redgi, heir to the Rat Throne, you must restore your broken Kingdom by banishing the merciless Frog Clan and their ferocious leader, Greenwart.
 
 As you explore the deceivingly charming world, you’ll encounter a cast of unique companions, ready to aid you in your adventure. And you’ll need all the help you can get, whether that’s new meal recipes, blueprints to forge deadly weapons and armour, or even a land-chugging, armour-plated mole mobile!
 
 Overcome your fears. Rescue your brothers. Restore Your Kingdom.
 
 Your tail has begun… Explore a Treacherous Kingdom 
 Fully accompanied by the deep, raspy narrations of the legendary Doug Cockle (celebrated within the world of RPGs), prepare to embark on an epic adventure across the mediaeval-fantasy Rat Kingdom. Complete side quests and faction hunts for some additional gold-on-the-side, or join forces with a sharp-eyed companion to help even the playing field.  
 
        Master Brutal Combat 
 From frog zombies to gargantuan grubs - and everything in-between - the Kingdom is awash with danger. To overcome each perilous encounter, you’ll need to study your opponent’s attacks and react accordingly! Thankfully, there’s a range of deadly abilities at your disposal, including parry bashes and fatal executions, not to mention ranged attacks with your nifty bow and arrow.
 
        Customise your Attack 
 Adapt Redgi’s combat style to the task at hand. Heavy armour may provide better protection but can you really afford to slow down your dodge-roll? And then there’s the question of weapon; axes pack a punch, while spears are quick and nimble. Perhaps you’d prefer the all-round performance of a trusty broadsword?
 
        Overcome Savage Boss Fights 
 While danger lurks around every toadstool, you’ll need to keep your wits sharp and your blade sharper when it comes to the devastating boss fights. Cold-blooded in every sense of the word, these oversized amphibians each present their own unique combat challenge, and you’ll need more than a good set of armour to come out on top.
 
        Brew Recipes, Craft Weapons, Forge Armour 
 Redgi’s keep is also home to his brothers, Rem-Rem, Bam-Bam and Dug. Rem can cook up a health-boosting feast with ingredients found throughout the world, while Bam can craft new weapons and armors from special blueprints you’ll uncover… if you look hard enough. And then there’s Dug, who’ll update you about new quests available throughout the Kingdom.
 
        Features: 
   Master brutal combat, inspired by the souls-like genre, featuring dodge-rolls, parry bashes, and fatal executions!
   Explore a vast and treacherous Kingdom, comprising six distinct biomes, each with its own hidden paths and secrets
   Immerse yourself in a compelling story, narrated by the deep, raspy vocals of the legendary Doug Cockle
   Customise your attack style with a vast array of distinct weapons and armour
   Assemble a band of brave companions, ready to aid you on select missions
   Complete side quests to earn additional gold-on-the-side
   Unearth special blueprints to forge new and powerful weapons
   Collect rare ingredients to cook up health-boosting feasts
   Overcome savage boss fights against the Frog Clan’s deadly, oversized generals
   Lose yourself in the gorgeous and lovingly-crafted 2D hand-drawn art style.

localized_description.text:
亮杉森林 - 免费扩展包        
  
  《铁尾传奇》 现已包含“ 亮杉森林 ”，这是第二部免费扩展包，续写了雷唧的王者之旅。这个终盘游戏扩展包内含 13 个全新任务（四个故事任务和九个支线任务），年轻的鼠国国王即将参加著名的松鼠落叶祭，鼹鼠竞技场新增三位全新挑战者，加入了新武器和新盔甲，进一步拓宽了角色定制选项，包括绯红城堡的八项外观升级，还有更多内容。
  
 疯狂的蛙族之王 绿疣 已被击败，森林正在召开欢乐的庆祝活动，但是，一种全新的两栖动物威胁可能很快就会从池塘的水藻丛中冒出来……雷唧能否克服新出现的威胁，及时赶回祭典，在甘美翠绿的亮杉树冠下享用一橡子杯的亮杉树液？
  
 你的故事还在继续……
 
  血须 - 免费扩展        
 
 《铁尾传奇》现已包含“血须”：该免费扩展包将带来全新的后期任务线、两种额外难度模式、五位全新Boss、一系列特殊盔甲与武器以及一个本应早已被遗忘的秘密...
 
 残暴无情的绿疣已被打败，雷唧国王的辽阔领土之上无不载歌载舞。但是刚刚加冕的救世主尚无法安稳地享受得来不易的宝座。按照鼠国自古以来的传统，新任的国王必须证明自己...并在一系列致命战斗中赢得胜利。
 
 打败来自五湖四海的勇猛战士，拿到先王房间的钥匙。一探其中隐藏的秘密。
 
 你的铁尾传奇仍将继续……
 
  关于游戏    
 
 《Tails of Iron》的背景设定在一个饱受战火摧残的阴暗大陆之上，玩家将在这款手绘风格的RPG冒险游戏之中经历一系列残酷战斗。作为鼠国的王位继承人雷唧，你的目标是光复已化为残垣断壁的王国，并终结残酷无情的蛙族，以及他们穷凶极恶的领袖，绿疣的威胁。
 
 在探索婀娜多姿却又危机四伏的世界的过程中，你将结识各式各样的独特同伴，他们将为你尽心竭力。对一切能帮助自己的优势来者不拒，搜集菜谱，通过设计图铸造致命武器与盔甲，或者是打造一辆披金带甲，神行百里的鼹鼠车！
 
 克服你的恐惧。拯救你的同胞。光复你的王国。
 
 你的传说才刚刚开始…… 挑战残酷的战斗 从蛙族僵尸到身形庞大的爬虫，王国之中危险重重。为了战胜每一次险象环生的遭遇战，你需要认真揣摩对手的攻击方式，兵来将挡水来土掩！但是不要担心，你也能运用一系列致命技能：招架反击，必杀处决，除此以外你还能用自己精准的长弓利箭发动远程攻击。
 
        探索危机四伏的王国 在传奇配音员Doug Cockle（在角色扮演游戏界广受赞誉）富有磁性的深沉旁白声中，跨越中世纪奇幻风格的老鼠王国，并踏上一段史诗冒险之旅。通过完成支线与狩猎任务获取额外资金，或者是与一名百步穿杨的同伴携手共进，两人合力，其利断金。
 
        多变的攻击风格 根据不同任务调整雷唧的战斗风格。重型盔甲能够提供良好保护，但是这能够抵消不便于躲避的劣势吗？除此以外，武器的选择也是大有学问：斧子威力强劲，但长矛则是迅猛而又灵活。或者说，你更倾向于八面玲珑的趁手阔剑？
 
        征服险象环生的Boss战 每一朵蘑菇背后都徘徊着看不见的危险，只有合理利用敏锐的头脑与锋利的快剑，方能克服致命凶险的Boss战。这些心狠手辣的两栖动物将为你带来独一无二的困难战斗，不要以为身披重甲就能轻松获胜。
 
        烹饪美食，制作武器，铸造盔甲 雷唧的城堡之中还寄宿着他的几位手足：雷姆姆，邦邦和挖挖。雷姆姆是个烹饪好手，只要给他提供从四处搜集来的食材，他就能为你烧制一顿强身健体的大餐；邦邦则可以通过找到的特殊设计图为你制作武器与盔甲……所以一定记得要擦亮自己的眼睛。除此以外还有挖挖，他将为你随时提供王国之中的各色任务情报。
 
        特色：   经历魂系风格的残酷战斗，翻滚，招架反击，必杀处决！
   跨越广袤而又危险的王国，探索六块独一无二的地区，发现其中隐藏的道路与秘密。
   在传奇配音员Doug Cockle富有磁性的深沉旁白声中，体验跌宕起伏的精彩故事。
   运用一系列独具特色的武器与盔甲，展现多变的攻击风格。
   招募一众勇敢同伴，并与他们一同执行任务
   通过完成支线任务获取额外资金
   搜集特殊设计图，铸造全新的强大武器
   收集稀有食材，烹饪强身健体的美味大餐
   对抗蛙族身形庞大的致命将领，征服险象环生的Boss战
   美轮美奂的手工2D美术风格将让你流连忘返。

《亮杉森林》——免費擴充        
  
  《鐵尾傳奇》  現正推出‘ 《亮杉森林》 ’，此第二个擴充將延續瑞基的王者旅程。這款破關後的擴充包含 13 個全新任務（四個主線劇情任務和九個支線任務），扮演年輕鼠王的玩家將前往松鼠們著名的落葉祭，遊戲新增了三個新來的鼴鼠競技場挑戰者，並擴增了角色自訂內容，加入全新武器和護甲，其中包括八款緋紅城堡的外觀升級選項，還有更多新內容等著玩家探索。
  
 狂惡的蛙族之王 青疣王 已被擊敗，然而，在森林歡欣鼓舞的同時，新的兩棲動物威脅可能隨時都會從池塘浮渣中洶湧而至……瑞基能否克服新到來的威脅，及時回歸家園，在鬱鬱蔥蔥的亮杉綠色樹蔭下享用橡子杯盛裝的冷杉汁液呢？
  
 你的傳奇故事還未結束……
 
  《血鬚》——免費擴充        
 
 《鐵尾傳奇》現在包含免費《血鬚》擴充，此擴充內含破關後的新任務、2 種額外新難度、5 個新魔王、各式各樣的新裝甲與武器以及一個不應該被提起的祕密……
 
 成功擊敗了殘暴的青疣王後，新王瑞基的王國上下無不歡欣鼓舞。但這位新上任的救世王者還不能坐上王座享受榮耀，根據鼠王國的古老傳統，新任國王必須證明自身價值……並進行一連串的生死戰鬥。
 
 打敗來自各地最殘暴凶狠的戰士，獲得先王房間的鑰匙，但房間內究竟藏了什麼可怕的祕密呢？
 
 你的傳奇故事還未結束……
 
  關於此遊戲    
 
 《鐵尾傳奇》的故事背景設定於受戰爭蹂躪的晦暗大地，是款手繪的 RPG 冒險遊戲，有著殘酷的格鬥元素。身為瑞基，鼠王國的繼位者，你必須驅逐殘酷無情的蛙族及他們兇殘的領袖 — 青疣王，以收復你那已殘破不堪的王國。
 
 而你在蠱惑迷人的世界中探險時，你將會遇到一群獨特的旅伴，準備在冒險旅途中祝你一臂之力。你將會需要所有可能的幫助：無論是新的食物食譜、鑄造致命武器及裝甲的藍圖，或是會大量挖土，又有裝甲防護的地鼠戰車！
 
 克服你的恐懼，拯救你的兄弟，收復你的王國。
 
 你的傳奇故事才正要開始…… 精通殘酷格鬥技巧 從青蛙殭屍到巨大的蛆 — 還有各式各樣其他的怪物 — 都讓王國深陷危險。為了克服各種危險的境遇，你必須研究對手的攻擊模式，並見招拆招！幸運的是，有許多致命的技能任你使用，包括劍法攻防和致命處決，更不用說那令人驚艷的弓箭造成的範圍技。
 
        在險境重重的王國中探險 沉浸於傳奇配音員道格・柯寇（角色扮演類遊戲廣為人熟悉的聲音）的深沉旁白中，準備好踏上史詩級歷險，橫跨整個中古奇幻的鼠王國。完成支線任務並擊倒各勢力，可額外獲得金幣，或與眼神銳利的同伴集結，更能在戰場上提供更大的協助。
 
        客製化你的攻擊招式 調整瑞基的戰鬥風格以在任務中游刃有餘。厚重的裝甲也許可以提供更好的保護，但你真的能承受躲避翻滾招式因此慢了下來嗎？接下來就要考慮武器：斧頭可造成重擊，但長矛迅捷又靈巧。也許你比較喜歡能施展全方面技能，可信賴的闊刀？
 
        克服野蠻的魔王決鬥 各種危險就隱藏在毒蕈之間，在破壞力強大的魔王戰鬥中，你必須足智多謀，將武器磨得更尖銳，才有獲勝的機會。這些巨大的兩棲類冷血無情，每個魔王都有獨特的格鬥挑戰，而你會需要精良的裝甲才能脫穎而出。

  About the Game    
 
 Set in a grim land plagued by war, Tails of Iron is a hand-drawn RPG Adventure with punishingly brutal combat. As Redgi, heir to the Rat Throne, you must restore your broken Kingdom by banishing the merciless Frog Clan and their ferocious leader, Greenwart.
 
 As you explore the deceivingly charming world, you’ll encounter a cast of unique companions, ready to aid you in your adventure. And you’ll need all the help you can get, whether that’s new meal recipes, blueprints to forge deadly weapons and armour, or even a land-chugging, armour-plated mole mobile!
 
 Overcome your fears. Rescue your brothers. Restore Your Kingdom.
 
 Your tail has begun… Explore a Treacherous Kingdom 
 Fully accompanied by the deep, raspy narrations of the legendary Doug Cockle (celebrated within the world of RPGs), prepare to embark on an epic adventure across the mediaeval-fantasy Rat Kingdom. Complete side quests and faction hunts for some additional gold-on-the-side, or join forces with a sharp-eyed companion to help even the playing field.  
 
        Master Brutal Combat 
 From frog zombies to gargantuan grubs - and everything in-between - the Kingdom is awash with danger. To overcome each perilous encounter, you’ll need to study your opponent’s attacks and react accordingly! Thankfully, there’s a range of deadly abilities at your disposal, including parry bashes and fatal executions, not to mention ranged attacks with your nifty bow and arrow.
 
        Customise your Attack 
 Adapt Redgi’s combat style to the task at hand. Heavy armour may provide better protection but can you really afford to slow down your dodge-roll? And then there’s the question of weapon; axes pack a punch, while spears are quick and nimble. Perhaps you’d prefer the all-round performance of a trusty broadsword?
 
        Overcome Savage Boss Fights 
 While danger lurks around every toadstool, you’ll need to keep your wits sharp and your blade sharper when it comes to the devastating boss fights. Cold-blooded in every sense of the word, these oversized amphibians each present their own unique combat challenge, and you’ll need more than a good set of armour to come out on top.
 
        Brew Recipes, Craft Weapons, Forge Armour 
 Redgi’s keep is also home to his brothers, Rem-Rem, Bam-Bam and Dug. Rem can cook up a health-boosting feast with ingredients found throughout the world, while Bam can craft new weapons and armors from special blueprints you’ll uncover… if you look hard enough. And then there’s Dug, who’ll update you about new quests available throughout the Kingdom.
 
        Features: 
   Master brutal combat, inspired by the souls-like genre, featuring dodge-rolls, parry bashes, and fatal executions!
   Explore a vast and treacherous Kingdom, comprising six distinct biomes, each with its own hidden paths and secrets
   Immerse yourself in a compelling story, narrated by the deep, raspy vocals of the legendary Doug Cockle
   Customise your attack style with a vast array of distinct weapons and armour
   Assemble a band of brave companions, ready to aid you on select missions
   Complete side quests to earn additional gold-on-the-side
   Unearth special blueprints to forge new and powerful weapons
   Collect rare ingredients to cook up health-boosting feasts
   Overcome savage boss fights against the Frog Clan’s deadly, oversized generals
   Lose yourself in the gorgeous and lovingly-crafted 2D hand-drawn art style.

  Acerca del juego    
 
 Tails of Iron, ambientado en un sombrío país asolado por la guerra, es una aventura de rol dibujada a mano, con combates de una dificultad brutal. Encarnando a Redgi, heredero al trono de las ratas, debes restituir tu reino desolado desterrando al despiadado clan de las ranas y a su feroz líder, Verruga Verde.
 
 Mientras exploras un mundo engañosamente encantador, conocerás a toda una serie de compañeros únicos, listos para ayudarte en tu aventura. Te vendrá bien cualquier ayuda que puedas conseguir, ya sean nuevas recetas de cocina, diseños para forjar armas mortíferas y armaduras o incluso un topomóvil blindado devorador de tierra.
 
 Supera tus miedos. Rescata a tus hermanos. Restituye tu reino.
 
 Comienza tu aventura... Domina un combate brutal El reino está plagado de peligros, desde ranas zombi hasta enormes grubs y muchos otros enemigos. ¡Para sobrevivir a todos estos peligrosos combates, tendrás que estudiar los ataques de tu rival y reaccionar en consecuencia! Afortunadamente, tienes a tu disposición toda una variedad de mortíferas habilidades, incluidos contraataques con escudo y ejecuciones letales, por no mencionar los sutiles ataques a distancia con arco y flechas.
 
        Explora un traicionero reino Prepárate para recorrer la ambientación de fantasía medieval del Reino de las ratas en una aventura épica narrada en todo momento por la voz profunda y ronca del legendario Doug Cockle (muy conocido en el mundo de los RPG). Completa misiones secundarias y cacerías para diversas facciones y consigue un poco de oro extra, o une fuerzas con un acompañante de mirada penetrante para nivelar el campo de juego.
 
        Personaliza tus ataques Adapta el estilo de combate de Redgi a cada situación. La armadura pesada protege más, pero ¿te viene bien perder velocidad al esquivar rodando? También hay que decidir qué arma usar: las hachas hacen mucho daño, mientras que las lanzas son rápidas y ligeras. Quizá prefieras recurrir a tu fiel espada ancha, eficaz en cualquier situación.
 
        Sobrevive a salvajes combates contra jefes Aunque el peligro acecha a cada paso, tendrás que pensar con claridad y actuar con destreza a la hora de enfrentarte a los devastadores combates contra los jefes. Cada uno de estos anfibios de sangre (literalmente) fría presenta un reto de combate diferente, y no te bastará con una buena armadura para salir bien parado.
 
        Prepara recetas, crea armas, forja armaduras En la fortaleza de Redgi también viven sus hermanos Rem-Rem, Bam-Bam y Dug. Rem puede preparar un festín para reponer tu salud con los ingredientes que encuentres por el mundo, mientras que Bam puede crear nuevas armas y armaduras con los diseños especiales que descubrirás... si buscas con atención. Luego está Dug, que te pondrá al tanto de las nuevas misiones disponibles por todo el reino.

  À propos du jeu    
 
 Tails of Iron est une aventure RPG dessinée à la main : elle est dotée d'un système de combat brutal et punitif et se déroule dans des contrées assombries par la guerre. Vous incarnez Redgi, héritier du Trône des Rats, et vous devez rétablir votre royaume déchu en bannissant le clan des Grenouilles et leur féroce leader, Greenwart.
 
 Au cours de vos explorations dans ce monde aux charmes trompeurs, vous rencontrerez des compagnons uniques prêts à vous suivre dans vos aventures. Et toute aide sera la bienvenue, que ce soit sous forme de nouvelles recettes, de plan d'armes mortelles ou d'armures ou même le soutien d'une au-taupe-mobile blindée !
 
 Surmontez vos peurs. Sauvez vos frères. Restaurez votre royaume.
 
 Votre conte commence... Maîtrisez les combats brutaux Les grenouilles zombies, les larves gigantesques, et bien d'autres formes de menace se terrent aux quatre coins du royaume. Pour surmonter chaque rencontre périlleuse, vous devrez étudier les attaques de vos adversaires et réagir de manière appropriée. Heureusement, vous avez à votre disposition toute une série de capacités mortellement efficaces, telles que les frappes défensives, les exécutions fatales et bien sûr les attaques à distance avec votre superbe arc et ses flèches.
 
        Explorez un royaume périlleux Préparez vous à embarquer dans une aventure épique au sein de la fantaisie médiévale du Royaume des rats en compagnie de la voix grave et rauque du légendaire Doug Cockle (célèbre dans le monde des RPG). Terminez des quêtes secondaires et des chasses de factions pour vous faire de l'or de poche, ou unissez vos forces avec celle d'un compagnon à l'œil aiguisé pour mettre à niveau les forces en présence.
 
        Personnalisez votre attaque Adaptez le style de combat de Redgi à la tâche à accomplir. Une armure lourde fournira une meilleure protection, mais pouvez-vous vraiment vous permettre de ralentir votre esquive roulée ? Et enfin la question du choix de votre arme ; les haches ont un impact garanti, mais les lances sont rapides et maniables. Peut-être préférez-vous les performances polyvalentes d'un fidèle sabre ?
 
        Surmontez des combats de boss sauvages Alors que le danger rôde au détour de chaque champignon vénéneux, vous devrez garder l'esprit vif et la lame affûtée lors des combats de boss dévastateurs. Rem sait préparer des festins boosters de santé avec les ingrédients découverts dans le monde, tandis que Bam sait fabriquer de nouvelles armes et armures à partir de plans spéciaux que vous découvrirez... en cherchant bien.   Infos zum Spiel    
 
 Tails of Iron ist ein handgezeichnetes RPG-Abenteuer mit gnadenlos harten Kämpfen. Das Spiel führt dich in ein düsteres Land, das von einem fürchterlichen Krieg heimgesucht wird. Führe als Redgi, Erbe des Rattenthrons, dein zerfallenes Königreich wieder zu altem Glanz, indem du den unbarmherzigen Frosch-Klan und ihren grimmigen Anführer Grünwarz vertreibst.
 
 Auf deiner Entdeckungsreise durch die trügerisch bezaubernde Welt triffst du einige eigentümliche Gefährten, die bereit sind, dich auf deinem Abenteuer zu unterstützen. Und du wirst alle Hilfe brauchen, die du kriegen kannst – egal, ob es um neue Rezepte für Gerichte, Pläne zur Herstellung tödlicher Waffen und Rüstungen oder sogar ein tuckerndes, gepanzertes Maulwurfsgefährt geht!
 
 Bezwinge deine Ängste. Rette deine Brüder. Hol dir dein Königreich zurück.
 
 Deine eiserne Geschichte hat gerade erst begonnen ...  Meistere brutale Kämpfe Von Froschzombies zu riesenhaften Larven und allem, was es sonst noch so gibt – das Königreich ist nur so von Gefahren überflutet. Um deine bedrohlichen Begegnungen überstehen zu können, musst du die Angriffe deiner Widersacher studieren und entsprechend darauf reagieren! Glücklicherweise steht dir eine Reihe von tödlichen Fähigkeiten zur Verfügung, darunter Parierschläge und verheerende Vollstreckungsangriffe. Außerdem kannst du mit deinem raffinierten Bogen via Distanzangriff Pfeile auf deine Gegner regnen lassen.
 
        Erkunde ein trügerisches Königreich Begib dich, begleitet von der dunklen, kratzigen Erzählstimme des legendären und in der Welt der Rollenspiele gefeierten Doug Cockle, auf ein episches Abenteuer durch das mittelalterliche Fantasy-Rattenkönigreich. Schließe Nebenquests und Fraktionsaufträge für ein wenig nebenher verdientes Gold ab oder schließe dich mit einem scharfsichtigen Gefährten zusammen, um auf dem Schlachtfeld für ausgewogenere Verhältnisse zu sorgen.
 
        Passe deine Angriffe an Passe Redgis Kampfstil an die bevorstehenden Aufträge an. Schwere Rüstung bietet womöglich besseren Schutz, aber kannst du dir wirklich eine langsamere Ausweichrolle leisten? Bleibt noch die Frage der Waffenwahl; Äxte sind schlagkräftig, Speere hingegen flink und behände. Oder vielleicht bevorzugst du ja die Vielseitigkeit des guten alten Breitschwerts?
 
        Überstehe schonungslose Bosskämpfe Die Gefahr mag zwar hinter jedem noch so kleinen Pilz lauern, du musst allerdings Verstand und Klinge noch wesentlich schneller führen, wenn einer der verheerende Bosskämpfe bevorsteht. Diese übergroßen Amphibien sind in jeder Hinsicht kaltblütig und stellen dich vor immer neue Kampfherausforderungen. Du brauchst mehr als nur eine gute Rüstung, um sie lebendig überstehen zu können.
 
        Rezepte brauen, Waffen herstellen, Rüstung schmieden Redgis Festung ist auch die Heimat seiner Brüder Rem-Rem, Bam-Bam und Dug. Aus den Zutaten, die du in der Welt finden kannst, kann dir Rem Speisen zubereiten, die sich positiv auf deine Gesundheit auswirken, während Bam neue Waffen und Rüstungsgegenstände schmieden kann, wenn du ihm die entsprechenden Pläne bringst ... halte also danach Ausschau. Und dann ist da noch Dug, der dich mit Nachrichten über neue Quests versorgt, die überall im Königreich verfügbar sind.
 
        Das Spiel:   Meistere brutale Kämpfe nach Art des Soulslike-Genres und vollführe Ausweichrollen, Parierschläge und tödliche Vollstreckungen!
   Erkunde ein weitreichendes, trügerisches Königreich mit sechs unterschiedlichen Lebensräumen – jeder von ihnen mit seinen eigenen Pfaden und Geheimnissen.
   Tauche in eine fesselnde Geschichte ein, die von niemand Geringerem als dem legendären Doug Cockle und dessen tiefer, kratziger Erzählstimme vorgetragen wird.
   Passe deinen Angriffsstil mit einem breiten Spektrum individueller Waffen und Rüstungen an.
   Stelle eine Gruppe tapferer Gefährten zusammen, die dir auf ausgewählten Missionen zur Seite steht.
   Schließe Nebenquests ab, um ein wenig zusätzliches Gold zu verdienen.
   Finde spezielle Pläne, um neue, mächtige Waffen schmieden zu können.

  Acerca do jogo    
 
 Tails of Iron é uma aventura RPG desenhada à mão que se desenrola numa terra sombria assolada pela guerra e conta com um combate imperdoável e brutal. Joga com Redgi, herdeiro do Trono dos Ratos, e expulsa o implacável Clã dos Sapos e o seu líder feroz, Greenwart, para restaurar o teu Reino destruído.
 
 À medida que exploras o mundo enganosamente encantador, encontrarás um elenco de companheiros únicos, prontos para te ajudarem na aventura. Vais precisar de toda a ajuda que conseguires obter, quer seja através de novas receitas, de esquemas para forjar armas e armaduras mortíferas, ou até mesmo de um veículo subterrâneo blindado triturador de solo!
 
 Supera os teus medos. Salva os teus irmãos. Restaura o teu reino.
 
 A tua história começou… Domina o combate brutal O Reino está repleto de perigos, desde sapos zombies até larvas gigantes (entre muitos outros). Para venceres cada encontro perigoso, terás de estudar os ataques dos teus adversários e reagir em conformidade! Felizmente, existem várias habilidades mortais à tua disposição, incluindo bloqueios de ataques e execuções fatais, sem esquecer os ataques à distância com arco e flecha.
 
        Explora um reino traiçoeiro Prepara-te para embarcar numa aventura épica pela fantasia medieval do Reino dos Ratos, totalmente acompanhado pelas narrações graves e roucas do lendário Doug Cockle (muito amado pelos jogadores de RPG de todo o mundo). Completa missões secundárias e caçadas de fações para receberes algum ouro adicional ou une forças a um companheiro perspicaz para ajudar a equilibrar o campo de batalha.
 
        Personaliza o teu ataque Adapta o estilo de combate de Redgi à tarefa em questão. As armaduras pesadas podem oferecer um nível de proteção superior, mas será que queres mesmo esquivar-te de maneira mais lenta? E depois há a questão das armas: os machados causam imenso dano, mas as lanças são rápidas e ágeis. Ou talvez prefiras a versatilidade proporcionada por uma fiel espada?
 
        Vence lutas brutais contra bosses À medida que o perigo espreita em cada cogumelo, terás de prestar muita atenção e manter a tua espada afiada no que toca às violentas lutas contra bosses. De sangue frio em todos os aspetos, cada um destes enormes anfíbios constitui um desafio de combate único, e precisarás de mais do que uma boa armadura para os venceres.
 
        Prepara receitas, cria armas e forja armaduras A fortaleza de Redgi também é a casa dos seus irmãos, Rem-Rem, Bam-Bam e Dug. Rem pode cozinhar um banquete regenerador de vida com ingredientes encontrados no mundo, ao passo que Bam pode criar novas armas e armaduras a partir dos esquemas especiais que descobrirás... se procurares o suficiente. E também tens o Dug, que irá manter-te ao corrente das novas missões disponíveis no Reino.
 
        Caraterísticas:   Domina o combate brutal, inspirado pelo género souls-like, com manobras para te esquivares, bloqueios de ataques e execuções fatais!
   Explora um Reino vasto e traiçoeiro, composto por seis biomas distintos, cada um com os seus próprios caminhos e segredos escondidos.
   Deixa-te envolver por uma história emocionante, narrada pela voz grave e rouca do lendário Doug Cockle.
   Personaliza o teu estilo de ataque com um vasto leque de armas e armaduras distintas.
   Forma uma equipa de companheiros corajosos, prontos para te ajudarem nas missões.
   Completa missões secundárias para ganhares ouro adicional.
   Descobre esquemas especiais para forjar novas armas poderosas.
   Recolhe ingredientes raros para cozinhares banquetes regeneradores de vida.
   Vence lutas selvagens contra bosses, tais como os enormes e mortíferos generais do Clã dos Sapos.
   Perde-te no deslumbrante estilo artístico em 2D carinhosamente desenhado à mão.

  ゲームについて    
 
 Tails of Ironは、紛争が蔓延した過酷な世界を舞台に、極めて残酷な戦いが繰り広げられる壮大なRPGアドベンチャー。プレイヤーはネズミ王の後継者、レジーとして崩壊した王国を再建すべく無慈悲なカエル一族とその残忍な指導者、グリーンワートとの戦いに身を投じることになります。
 
 裏の顔を持つ美しい世界を冒険していると、あなたの力になってくれる個性的な仲間たちに出会うことになります。さらに料理のレシピや強力な武器やアーマーの設計図、地面をかき分け装甲をまとうモグラモービルまで、役に立つものは何でも活用しましょう！
 
 恐怖を乗り越え、兄弟を助け出し、王国を再建せよ。
 
 ここからあなたの物語が始まる… 残酷な戦闘をマスターせよ カエルゾンビから巨大な幼虫まで、王国にはあらゆる危険が潜んでいます。このような状況を乗り越えるには、相手の攻撃を見極め、臨機応変に行動することが求められるでしょう！ありがたいことに、あなたは弓矢を使った遠距離攻撃はもちろん、カウンター攻撃や致命攻撃などの強力なアビリティを豊富に備えています。
 
        危険だらけの王国を探索 伝説のダグ・コックル（RPG界の有名声優）が贈る深みのあるしわがれた声のナレーションと共に、架空の中世時代を舞台にしたネズミ王国を巡る壮大な冒険に備えましょう。ゴールドを求めてサイドクエストや派閥争いに参加したり、鋭い目を持つ仲間と手を組み競技場で活躍することも可能です。
 
        攻撃をカスタマイズ 必要に応じてレジ―の戦闘スタイルを変化させましょう。重装甲を装備すれば防御力は高くなりますが、回避行動に問題はありませんか？斧の一撃は強力ですが、槍にも素早さ取り回しの良さなどの長所があります。万能なブロードソードはきっとお気に入りの一本になるはずです。
 
        強大なボス戦を乗り越えろ 毒キノコの周囲には危険がいっぱいです。強力なボスに勝利するには常に考え武器を研ぎ澄ますことが肝心です。文字通り冷血な巨大両生類たちにはそれぞれ独自の戦闘チャレンジが用意されており、頂点に立つには良質な装備が必要となるでしょう。
 
        レシピの料理を作り、武器やアーマーを製造しよう レジ―の砦は、彼の兄弟であるレムレム、バムバム、ダグの家でもあります。レムは冒険で見つけた食材で体力をつく料理を作り、バムは新たな武器やアーマーを入手できる特別な設計図から製造することが可能です。設計図はそう簡単には見つかりませんが…それからダグは王国で受けられるクエストを更新する役割を担っています。
 
        特徴:    回避行動やカウンター攻撃、致命攻撃などソウルライク作品に影響を受けた、残酷な戦闘をマスターしよう！

  About the Game    
 
 Set in a grim land plagued by war, Tails of Iron is a hand-drawn RPG Adventure with punishingly brutal combat. As Redgi, heir to the Rat Throne, you must restore your broken Kingdom by banishing the merciless Frog Clan and their ferocious leader, Greenwart.
 
 As you explore the deceivingly charming world, you’ll encounter a cast of unique companions, ready to aid you in your adventure. And you’ll need all the help you can get, whether that’s new meal recipes, blueprints to forge deadly weapons and armour, or even a land-chugging, armour-plated mole mobile!
 
 Overcome your fears. Rescue your brothers. Restore Your Kingdom.
 
 Your tail has begun… Explore a Treacherous Kingdom 
 Fully accompanied by the deep, raspy narrations of the legendary Doug Cockle (celebrated within the world of RPGs), prepare to embark on an epic adventure across the mediaeval-fantasy Rat Kingdom. Complete side quests and faction hunts for some additional gold-on-the-side, or join forces with a sharp-eyed companion to help even the playing field.  
 
        Master Brutal Combat 
 From frog zombies to gargantuan grubs - and everything in-between - the Kingdom is awash with danger. To overcome each perilous encounter, you’ll need to study your opponent’s attacks and react accordingly! Thankfully, there’s a range of deadly abilities at your disposal, including parry bashes and fatal executions, not to mention ranged attacks with your nifty bow and arrow.
 
        Customise your Attack 
 Adapt Redgi’s combat style to the task at hand. Heavy armour may provide better protection but can you really afford to slow down your dodge-roll? And then there’s the question of weapon; axes pack a punch, while spears are quick and nimble. Perhaps you’d prefer the all-round performance of a trusty broadsword?
 
        Overcome Savage Boss Fights 
 While danger lurks around every toadstool, you’ll need to keep your wits sharp and your blade sharper when it comes to the devastating boss fights. Cold-blooded in every sense of the word, these oversized amphibians each present their own unique combat challenge, and you’ll need more than a good set of armour to come out on top.
 
        Brew Recipes, Craft Weapons, Forge Armour 
 Redgi’s keep is also home to his brothers, Rem-Rem, Bam-Bam and Dug. Rem can cook up a health-boosting feast with ingredients found throughout the world, while Bam can craft new weapons and armors from special blueprints you’ll uncover… if you look hard enough. And then there’s Dug, who’ll update you about new quests available throughout the Kingdom.

  Om spillet    
 
 Tails of Iron, der udspiller sig i et krigshærget land, er et håndtegnet rollespil med benhårde kampe. Som Redgi, der er arving til rottetronen, skal du genopbygge dit ødelagte rige ved at fordrive en nådesløse frøklan og deres brutale leder Greenwart.

Der er også spørgsmålet om våben: Økserne slår hårdt, og spyddene er lette og hurtige. Måske foretrækker du et godt allroundvåben som det trofaste slagsværd?

  Informazioni sul gioco    
 
 Ambientato in un lugubre mondo devastato dalla guerra, Tails of Iron è un'avventura GDR disegnata a mano e con combattimenti davvero brutali. Nei panni di Redgi, l'erede al trono dei ratti, dovrai ricostruire il tuo regno scacciando lo spietato clan delle rane e il suo feroce capo, Verruca Verde.
 
 Esplorando un mondo affascinante quanto letale, incontrerai un gruppo di compagni unici, pronti ad aiutarti nell'avventura. E avrai bisogno di tutto l'aiuto possibile: da nuove ricette di cucina a progetti per forgiare armature e armi micidiali, a una talpamobile blindata inghiotti-terra!
 
 Supera le tue paure. Salva i tuoi fratelli. Ricostruisci il tuo regno.
 
 Inizia la tua storia... Padroneggia il brutale combattimento Rane zombi, larve gigantesche e molto altro: il regno pullula di minacce. Per superare tutti i pericolosi incontri dovrai studiare gli attacchi dell'avversario e reagire di conseguenza! Per fortuna avrai a disposizione diverse abilità letali, incluse parate ed esecuzioni fatali, per non parlare degli attacchi a distanza con arco e frecce.
 
        Esplora un pericoloso regno Con la ruvida voce del leggendario Doug Cockle (molto apprezzato nel mondo dei GdR) a narrare gli eventi, vivi un'epica avventura fantasy medievale nel Regno dei ratti. Completa missioni secondarie e incarichi della fazione per ottenere più oro, oppure collabora con un acuto compagno che ti aiuterà nell'impresa.
 
        Personalizza il tuo attacco Adatta lo stile di combattimento di Redgi in base alle necessità. L'armatura pesante offre più protezione, ma varrà la pena perdere velocità in rotolata e schivata? Poi c'è il problema delle armi: le asce infliggono molti danni, ma le lance sono agili e veloci. O magari preferisci uno spadone, affidabile e ben bilanciato?
 
        Sconfiggi feroci boss Anche se il pericolo si annida dietro ogni fungo velenoso, dovrai tenere sempre la concentrazione alta e la spada pronta quando ti troverai ad affrontare i temibili scontri con i boss. Questi anfibi giganti hanno un gran sangue freddo (in tutti i sensi) e ciascuno presenta una diversa sfida: per batterli non ti basterà solo una bella armatura.
 
        Crea ricette, forgia armi e armature La fortezza di Redgi è anche la dimora dei suoi fratelli Rem-Rem, Bam-Bam e Dug. Rem è in grado di cucinare cibi che potenziano la salute con gli ingredienti trovati nel mondo, mentre Bam può creare nuove armi e armature con gli speciali progetti che troverai nascosti in giro. E poi c'è Dug, che ti informerà su tutte le nuove missioni disponibili nel regno.
 
        Caratteristiche:   Padroneggia il brutale combattimento ispirato al genere souls-like, che offre schivate in rotolata, parate ed esecuzioni fatali!
   Esplora un vasto e pericoloso regno composto di sei diversi biomi, ognuno con percorsi e segreti nascosti
   Lasciati coinvolgere dalla storia avvincente narrata dalla voce ruvida e profonda del leggendario Doug Cockle.
   Personalizza il tuo stile d'attacco con una vasta gamma di armi e armature diverse
   Metti insieme un gruppo di coraggiosi compagni che ti aiuteranno nelle missioni
   Completa le missioni secondarie per ricevere oro
   Scopri speciali progetti per forgiare nuove e potenti armi
   Raccogli ingredienti rari per cucinare piatti che potenziano la salute
   Trionfa in feroci combattimenti contro i generali giganti del clan delle rane
   Ammira lo splendido stile di disegno 2D realizzato a mano

game.brief:
Bright Fir Forest - Free Expansion        
  
  Tails of Iron  now includes ‘ Bright Fir Forest ’, a second free expansion that continues Redgi’s regal journey. Featuring 13 new quests (four story quests and nine side quests) this end-game expansion takes the young Rat King to the Squirrels’ renowned Festival of Leaf Fall, adds three new challengers in the Mole Arena, further broadens character customisation with new weapons and armour, includes eight cosmetic upgrades for the Crimson Keep, and more.
  
 King of Frogkind, the maniacal  Greenwart  has been vanquished, but despite the joyous celebrations in the forest, a new amphibious menace may be about to bubble through the pond scum… can Redgi overcome the emerging threat and be back in time to enjoy an acorn cup of Bright Sap under the luscious green canopies of Bright Fir?
  
 Your tail continues…
 
  Bloody Whiskers - Free Expansion        
 
  Tails of Iron  now includes ‘ Bloody Whiskers ’: a free expansion which introduces a new post-game questline, two additional difficulty modes, five new bosses, a selection of special armours and weapons, and a secret that was perhaps better left forgotten…
 
 With the tyrannical  Greenwart  now defeated, King  Redgi’s  vast lands chime with celebration. But the recently crowned saviour isn’t free to rest easy on his throne just yet. As decreed by an ancient Rat tradition, the new King must prove his worth… in a deadly trial of combat.
 
 Defeat the most lethal warriors from across the land to claim the key to the old King’s room. But what heinous secret lurks within?
 
 Your tail continues…
 
  About the Game    
 
 Set in a grim land plagued by war, Tails of Iron is a hand-drawn RPG Adventure with punishingly brutal combat. As Redgi, heir to the Rat Throne, you must restore your broken Kingdom by banishing the merciless Frog Clan and their ferocious leader, Greenwart.
 
 As you explore the deceivingly charming world, you’ll encounter a cast of unique companions, ready to aid you in your adventure. And you’ll need all the help you can get, whether that’s new meal recipes, blueprints to forge deadly weapons and armour, or even a land-chugging, armour-plated mole mobile!
 
 Overcome your fears. Rescue your brothers. Restore Your Kingdom.
 
 Your tail has begun… Explore a Treacherous Kingdom 
 Fully accompanied by the deep, raspy narrations of the legendary Doug Cockle (celebrated within the world of RPGs), prepare to embark on an epic adventure across the mediaeval-fantasy Rat Kingdom. Complete side quests and faction hunts for some additional gold-on-the-side, or join forces with a sharp-eyed companion to help even the playing field.  
 
        Master Brutal Combat 
 From frog zombies to gargantuan grubs - and everything in-between - the Kingdom is awash with danger. To overcome each perilous encounter, you’ll need to study your opponent’s attacks and react accordingly! Thankfully, there’s a range of deadly abilities at your disposal, including parry bashes and fatal executions, not to mention ranged attacks with your nifty bow and arrow.
 
        Customise your Attack 
 Adapt Redgi’s combat style to the task at hand. Heavy armour may provide better protection but can you really afford to slow down your dodge-roll? And then there’s the question of weapon; axes pack a punch, while spears are quick and nimble. Perhaps you’d prefer the all-round performance of a trusty broadsword?
 
        Overcome Savage Boss Fights 
 While danger lurks around every toadstool, you’ll need to keep your wits sharp and your blade sharper when it comes to the devastating boss fights. Cold-blooded in every sense of the word, these oversized amphibians each present their own unique combat challenge, and you’ll need more than a good set of armour to come out on top.
 
        Brew Recipes, Craft Weapons, Forge Armour 
 Redgi’s keep is also home to his brothers, Rem-Rem, Bam-Bam and Dug. Rem can cook up a health-boosting feast with ingredients found throughout the world, while Bam can craft new weapons and armors from special blueprints you’ll uncover… if you look hard enough. And then there’s Dug, who’ll update you about new quests available throughout the Kingdom.
 
        Features: 
   Master brutal combat, inspired by the souls-like genre, featuring dodge-rolls, parry bashes, and fatal executions!
   Explore a vast and treacherous Kingdom, comprising six distinct biomes, each with its own hidden paths and secrets
   Immerse yourself in a compelling story, narrated by the deep, raspy vocals of the legendary Doug Cockle
   Customise your attack style with a vast array of distinct weapons and armour
   Assemble a band of brave companions, ready to aid you on select missions
   Complete side quests to earn additional gold-on-the-side
   Unearth special blueprints to forge new and powerful weapons
   Collect rare ingredients to cook up health-boosting feasts
   Overcome savage boss fights against the Frog Clan’s deadly, oversized generals
   Lose yourself in the gorgeous and lovingly-crafted 2D hand-drawn art style.

game.title: Kingdom Two Crowns
game.description:
10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  About the Game        
    Build - Explore - Defend - Conquer    
  A shroud of mystery envelops these uncharted medieval lands where ancient monuments, relics and mythical creatures await. Echoes of bygone eras speak of past greatness and in Kingdom Two Crowns, part of the award-winning franchise Kingdom, you embark on an adventure as the Monarch. In this side-scrolling journey atop your steed, you recruit loyal subjects, build your kingdom and protect your crown from the Greed, monstrous creatures looking to steal your kingdom's treasures.  
  Journey alone or together - in Kingdom Two Crowns, a duo of Monarchs can work cooperatively to build and forge a Kingdom that stands the test of time.   
        
  Lay the foundation of a mighty Kingdom with towering walls and protecting towers while cultivating prosperity through building farms and recruiting villagers. In Kingdom Two Crowns expanding and growing your Kingdom grants access to new units and technologies.   
        
  Venture into the unknown beyond the protection of your borders, through secluded forests and ancient ruins to seek treasures and hidden knowledge to aid your quest. Who knows what legendary artifacts or mythological beings you will find.  
        
  As the night falls, shadows come to life and the monstrous Greed assaults your kingdom. Rally your troops, muster your courage, and steel yourself, for each night will demand ever-growing feats of tactical mastermind. Deploy archers, knights, siege weapons, and even newfound Monarch abilities and artifacts to hold against the waves of Greed.  
        
  As the monarch, lead assaults against the source of the Greed to secure your islands. Send your groups of soldiers to clash with the enemy. A word of caution: make sure your troops are prepared and sufficient in numbers, as the Greed will not go down without a fight.   
        
  Kingdom Two Crowns is an evolving experience that includes several free content updates:   
     Shogun:  Journey to lands inspired by the architecture and culture of feudal Japan. Play as the mighty Shogun or Onna-bugeisha, enlist the ninja, lead your soldiers to battle atop the mythological Kirin, and form new strategies as you brave the Greed hiding in thick bamboo forests.  
     Dead Lands:  Enter the dark lands of Kingdom. Play as unique Monarchs, including the Shardbinder Miriam, with powerful traits from the gothic horror action-RPG Bloodstained. Ride the gigantic beetle to lay out traps, the eerie undead steed that summons barriers impeding the progress of the Greed, or the mythical demon horse Gamigin from Bloodstained, with its powerful charge attack.   
     Challenge Islands:  Representing the greatest challenge ever seen for hardened veteran monarchs.  Take on five challenges with different rules and objectives. Can you survive long enough to claim the gold crown?  
    Your adventure is only the beginning. Explore more untold stories and settings in the additional DLCs and content available for the game. Oh Monarch, stay vigilant for dark nights are still to come, protect your crown!

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  Acerca del juego        
   Construye - Explora - Defiende - Conquista 
  Un manto de misterio envuelve estas inexploradas tierras medievales en las que convergen reliquias, monumentos antiguos y criaturas míticas. Los ecos de eras pasadas cuentan historias de grandeza y, en Kingdom Two Crowns, que pertenece a la galardonada franquicia Kingdom, puedes vivir esta aventura poniéndote en el papel de monarca. En este viaje con desplazamiento lateral a lomos de tu corcel, podrás reclutar a leales súbditos, construir tu propio reino y proteger la corona de los ávidos, unas monstruosas criaturas que intentar robar los tesoros del reino.
  Afronta este viaje a solas o en compañía. En Kingdom Two Crowns, un dúo de monarcas puede cooperar para construir y forjar un reino que perdure por los siglos de los siglos.
        
  Pon los cimientos de un poderoso reino con muros altos y torres de defensa, y hazlo prosperar construyendo granjas y reclutando aldeanos. En Kingdom Two Crowns, expandir y desarrollar tu reino te dará acceso a nuevas unidades y tecnologías.
        
  Abandona la seguridad de tus fronteras y adéntrate en lo desconocido. Recorre bosques solitarios y ruinas antiguas en busca de tesoros y sabiduría oculta que te ayudarán en tu misión. ¿Qué artefactos legendarios y seres mitológicos encontrarás por el camino?
        
  Al caer la noche, las sombras cobran vida y los monstruosos ávidos atacan tu reino. Reúne a tus tropas y ármate de valor, pues todas noches deberás demostrar un nivel de habilidad estratégica mayor que el día anterior. Para resistir a las oleadas de ávidos, tendrás que desplegar arqueros, caballeros y armas de asedio, además de hacer uso de las habilidades y artefactos que solo tú posees como monarca.
        
  Como monarca, deberás organizar asaltos contra el lugar de origen de los ávidos para proteger tu isla. Envía grupos de soldados para que luchen frente a frente con el enemigo. Como medida de precaución, procura asegurarte de que tus tropas estén preparadas y sean suficientes en número; los ávidos no se rinden ante nada.
        
  Kingdom Two Crowns es una experiencia en constante evolución que incluye varias actualizaciones de contenido gratuitas:
     Shogun : Viaja a tierras inspiradas en la arquitectura y la cultura del Japón feudal. Juega como un poderoso shogun o una onna-bugeisha, consigue el apoyo de los ninja, guía a tus soldados a la batalla a lomos de un mítico quilin, e idea nuevas estrategias mientras te enfrentas a los ávidos escondidos entre los densos bosques de bambú.
     Dead Lands : Adéntrate en las tierras más oscuras de Kingdom. Juega como varios monarcas únicos, incluida la unefragmentos Miriam, con poderosos rasgos inspirados en el RPG de acción y horror gótico Bloodstained.
     Islas de desafíos : Hasta los monarcas curtidos en mil batallas tendrán que esforzarse al máximo para superar este reto. Acepta cinco desafíos con distintas normas y objetivos. ¿Serás capaz de sobrevivir el tiempo necesario para hacerte con la corona de oro?
    Tu aventura es solo el principio. Explora más historias sin contar y ubicaciones sin descubrir con todo el contenido descargable adicional disponible para el juego. ¡Oh, monarca, no bajes la guardia ni un segundo! ¡Te esperan muchas noches oscuras y es tu deber proteger la corona!

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  À propos du jeu        
   Bâtir - Explorer - Défendre - Conquérir  
  Un voile de mystère recouvre ces terres médiévales inexplorées où vous attendent monuments antiques, reliques mystérieuses et créatures mythiques. Les échos d'époques lointaines sont empreints de gloire perdue, et avec Kingdom Two Crowns, nouveau titre de la série primée Kingdom, vous embarquez dans une nouvelle aventure en tant que monarque. Dans ce périple en défilement latéral, vous recruterez de loyaux sujets, bâtirez votre royaume et protégerez votre couronne contre les Rapaces, des créatures monstrueuses avides de trésors.
  Voyagez seul ou à deux. Dans Kingdom Two Crowns, un duo de monarques peut coopérer pour bâtir et forger un royaume à l'épreuve du temps.  
        
  Posez les bases d'un puissant royaume en érigeant de hautes murailles et des tours défensives, et assurez votre prospérité en construisant des fermes et en recrutant des villageois. Dans Kingdom Two Crowns, la croissance et l'expansion de votre royaume vous donnent accès à de nouvelles unités et technologies.  
        
  Plongez vers l'inconnu au-delà de vos frontières, à travers des forêts perdues et des ruines antiques à la recherche de trésors cachés et de savoirs oubliés qui vous aideront dans votre quête. Qui sait quels artefacts légendaires et créatures mythiques vous découvrirez ?
        
  Quand tombe la nuit, les ombres prennent vie et les terribles Rapaces assaillent votre royaume. Ralliez vos troupes, rassemblez votre courage et prenez les armes, car chaque nouvelle nuit exigera toujours plus de prouesses tactiques de votre part. Déployez archers, chevaliers et engins de siège, et exploitez vos artefacts et vos capacités de monarque pour repousser les hordes de Rapaces. 
        
  En tant que monarque, menez l'assaut contre la source des Rapaces pour sécuriser vos îles. Envoyez vos soldats affronter l'ennemi, mais attention : veillez à ce que vos troupes soient suffisamment nombreuses et bien préparées, car les Rapaces ne se rendront pas sans combattre.  
        
  Kingdom Two Crowns est un jeu en constante évolution qui inclut déjà plusieurs mises à jour de contenu gratuites :
     Shogun  : Découvrez une terre inspirée de l'architecture et de la culture du Japon féodal. Incarnez un puissant Shogun ou une grande Onna-bugeisha, faites appel aux ninjas pour vous aider, menez vos soldats au combat en chevauchant le mythologique Kirin et élaborez de nouvelles stratégies pour vaincre les Rapaces qui se cachent dans l'épaisse forêt de bambous.
     Dead Lands  : Aventurez-vous dans les terres les plus sombres de Kingdom. Incarnez des monarques uniques, tels que la lieuse d'éclats Miriam, tirés du RPG d'action d'horreur gothique Bloodstained.
     Îles des défis  : La plus grande épreuve jamais vue, réservée aux monarques vétérans. Relevez cinq défis aux règles et aux objectifs variés. Survivrez-vous assez longtemps pour vous emparer de la couronne d'or ?
    Votre aventure n'est qu'un début. Explorez d'autres lieux et récits dans les DLC et le contenu additionnel du jeu. Restez vigilant, monarque, car les nuits s'annoncent sombres et pleines de périls pour votre couronne !

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  Infos zum Spiel       
 
   Bauen – Erkunden – Verteidigen – Erobern   
 
 Diese unerforschten, mittelalterlichen Lande mit uralten Monumenten, Relikten und mythischen Kreaturen sind von großen Geheimnissen umgeben. Echos vergangener Zeiten zeugen von längst vergangener Größe. In Kingdom Two Crowns, aus der Reihe des preisgekrönten Franchise Kingdom, stürzt ihr euch als Monarchen ins Abenteuer. Auf eurer seitwärts scrollenden Reise hoch zu Ross rekrutiert ihr treue Untertanen, baut euer Königreich auf und beschützt die Krone vor den Habgierigen, den monströsen Kreaturen, die die Schätze eures Königreichs rauben wollen.
 
 Reist allein oder zweit – in Kingdom Two Crowns können sich Monarchen zu einem Duo zusammenschließen, um ein Königreich zu errichten, das die Zeiten überdauert.
 
       
 
 Legt die Basis für ein mächtiges Königreich mit hohen Mauern, schützenden Türmen und sorgt für Wohlstand, indem ihr Bauernhöfe baut und Dorfbewohner anheuert. In Kingdom Two Crowns verschafft euch das Erweitern eures Königreichs Zugriff auf neue Einheiten und Technologien.
  
       
 
 Wagt euch ins Unbekannte jenseits eurer Grenzen hinaus, durch abgeschiedene Wälder und alte Ruinen, um Schätze und verborgenes Wissen zu suchen, die euch auf euer Quest helfen. Niemand weiß, auf welche legendären Artefakte oder mythische Wesen ihr stoßt.
 
       
 
 Bei Einbruch der Nacht erwachen die Schatten zum Leben und monströse Habgierige greifen euer Königreich an. Versammelt eure Truppen, nehmt allen Mut zusammen und wappnet euch, denn in jeder Nacht sind taktische Meisterleistungen gefragt. Entsendet Bogenschützen, Ritter, Belagerungswaffen, und setzt neue Monarchenfähigkeiten und Artefakte ein, um den Wellen der Habgierigen standzuhalten.
 
       
 
 Führt als Monarch Angriffe gegen die Quelle der Habgierigen durch, um eure Inseln zu schützen. Schickt Soldaten los, damit sie sich dem Gegner stellen. Aber vergesst nicht: Sorgt dafür, dass eure Truppen vorbereitet und in ausreichender Stärke vorhanden sind, da sich die Habgierigen nicht kampflos ergeben.
 
       
 
 Kingdom Two Crowns ist ein sich entwickelndes Erlebnis, das mehrere kostenlose Inhalts-Updates umfasst: 
 
    Shogun:  Reist in Länder, die von der Architektur und Kultur des feudalen Japan inspiriert sind. Spielt als mächtiger Shogun oder Onna-bugeisha, sichert euch die Unterstützung der Ninja, führt eure Soldaten auf dem Rücken des mythologischen Kirin in die Schlacht und entwickelt neue Strategien im Kampf gegen die Habgierigen, die sich in den dichten Bambuswäldern versteckt halten.
    Dead Lands:  Betretet die dunklen Lande von Kingdom. Spielt einzigartige Monarchen wie die Scherbenbinderin Miriam mit mächtigen Fähigkeiten aus dem Gothic-Horror-Rollenspiel Bloodstained. Reitet auf dem gigantischen Riesenkäfer, dem unheimlichen untoten Reittier, das Barrieren heraufbeschwört, und legt Fallen aus, die das Fortschreiten der Habgierigen behindern. Oder reitet auf dem mythischen Dämonenross ""Gamigin"" aus Bloodstained – mit seinem mächtigen Sturmangriff.
    Herausforderungsinseln:  Dies ist die größte Herausforderung – selbst für abgehärtete Monarchen. Stellt euch fünf Herausforderungen mit unterschiedlichen Regeln und Zielen. Überlebt ihr lang genug, um euch die Krone zu holen?  
 Euer Abenteuer ist erst der Anfang. Erkundet noch nicht erzählte Geschichten und Umgebungen in zusätzlichen DLCs und Inhalten, die für das Spiel verfügbar sind. Oh, Monarchen, bleibt wachsam, denn dunkle Nächte stehen euch bevor ... beschützt die Krone!

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  Acerca do jogo        
 
  Constrói - Explora - Defende - Conquista 
  Uma névoa misteriosa envolve terras medievais, onde monumentos, relíquias e criaturas míticas esperam por ti. Ecos de eras passadas relatam a grandeza de outrora no Kingdom Two Crowns, parte da galardoada série Kingdom, onde partirás numa aventura no papel de Monarch. Nesta aventura de deslocação lateral, terás de montar o teu cavalo, recrutar súbditos fiéis, construir o teu reino e proteger a coroa do Greed: um bando de criaturas monstruosas que pretende roubar os tesouros do reino.
  Aventura-te a solo ou com companhia. No Kingdom Two Crowns, uma dupla de Monarchs pode colaborar para criar um reino eterno.
        
  Prepara as bases do teu reino com muralhas e torres gigantescas, sem esquecer a prosperidade através da construção de quintas e recrutamento de súbditos. No Kingdom Two Crowns, a expansão do reino é a única forma de encontrar novas unidades e tecnologias.
        
  Aventura-te no desconhecido para lá das tuas fronteiras, através de florestas isoladas e ruínas ancestrais, e procura tesouros e conhecimento até cumprires a tua missão. Pelo caminho, talvez também encontres artefactos lendários e criaturas mitológicas!
        
  Com o cair da noite, as trevas ganham vida... na forma do monstruoso Greed! Reúne tropas, ganha coragem e prepara-te para enfrentar esta ameaça ao teu reino, pois cada noite vai obrigar-te a encontrar novas soluções estratégicas. Posiciona arqueiros, cavaleiros, catapultas e novas habilidades e artefactos do Monarch para sobreviver às hordas do Greed.
        
  Lidera assaltos contra a origem do Greed e protege as tuas ilhas. Envia exércitos para destruírem o inimigo, mas tem cuidado. Verifica sempre se as tuas tropas estão ao nível dos números surpreendentes do Greed.
        
  O Kingdom Two Crowns é uma experiência envolvente que inclui várias atualizações de conteúdo:
     Shogun : viaja até territórios inspirados pela arquitetura e cultura do Japão feudal. Joga com Shogun ou Onna-bugeisha, pede a ajuda de ninjas, lidera exércitos no topo da mítica Kirin e forma novas estratégias para enfrentares o Greed nas florestas de bambu.
     Dead Lands : explora os territórios mais sombrios do reino. Joga com os Monarchs, incluindo a Shardbinder Miriam do RPG gótico de terror Bloodstained.
     Challenge Islands : o maior desafio de sempre, até para os Monarchs mais experientes. Enfrenta cinco desafios com regras e objetivos distintos. Serás capaz de sobreviver e reclamar a coroa de ouro?
    A tua aventura ainda está no início. Explora mais histórias inéditas e configurações com os DLCs e conteúdos disponíveis. Monarch, protege a coroa e mantém-te vigilante, há noites sombrias a chegar!

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  Om spillet        
   Byg – Udforsk – Forsvar – Erobring 
  Mystikken indhyller de uudforskede middelalderlige riger, hvor ældgamle monumenter, relikvier og mytiske væsner venter. Ekkoet fra en svunden tid fortæller om tidligere tiders storhed. I Kingdom Two Crowns, som er en del af den prisbelønnede Kingdom-serie, drager du ud på et eventyr som en ridende monark, der må rekruttere undersåtter, opbygge et rige og beskytte kronen med The Greed, som er en flok monsterlignende skabninger, der vil stjæle rigets skatte.
  Rejs alene eller sammen med andre – i Kingdom Two Crowns kan to monarker samarbejde om at opbygge et stort og varigt rige.
        
  Læg fundamentet til et storslået kongerige med højre mure og forsvarstårne, mens du sørger for fremgang ved at etablere gårde og rekruttere landsbyboere. I Kingdom Two Crowns får du adgang til nye enheder og ny teknologi, når dit kongerige vokser.
        
  Rejs uden for dit riges beskyttende grænser, gennem fjerne skove og oldgamle ruiner for at finde skatte og skjult viden, der kan hjælpe dig undervejs. Hvem ved, hvad du kan finde af legendariske artefakter og mytiske væsner.
        
  Når natten sænker sig, vågner skyggerne, og de monsteragtige væsner kaldet The Greed angriber kongeriget. Saml din hær, vær modig og gør dig klar, for hver eneste nat kræver, at du bliver klogere og udvikler dine taktiske færdigheder. Placér bueskytter, riddere og belejringsvåben, og brug nye monarkfædigheder og artefakter for at kæmpe mod horder af The Greed.
        
  Som monark fører du an i angreb mod kilden til The Greed for at sikre dine øer. Send grupper af soldater ud for at kæmpe mod fjenden. En lille advarsel: Sørg for, at din hær er klar og mægtig nok, da The Greed ikke overgiver sig uden kamp.
        
  Kingdom Two Crowns er en spiloplevelse under konstant udvikling og med flere gratis opdateringer:
     Shogun : Rejs til lande med arkitektur, der er inspireret af det feudale Japan. Spil som en mægtig shogun eller Onna-bugeisha, hverv ninjaer, før dine soldater i kamp på toppen af det mytologiske Kirin, og læg nye strategier, mens du kæmper mod The Greed i tætte bambusskove.
     Dead Lands : Udforsk de mørkeste afkroge af kongeriget. Spil som forskellige monarker, inklusive Shardbinder Miriam, med inspiration fra det gotiske actiongyserspil Bloodstained.
     Udfordringsøer : Den største udfordring nogensinde til benhårde veteranmonarker. Kast dig ud i fem udfordringer med forskellige regler og mål. Kan du overleve længe nok til at tage guldkronen?
    Dit eventyr er kun lige begyndt. Udforsk flere historier og omgivelser i downloadpakker med masser af nyt indhold til spillet. Vær opmærksom og modig i den mørke nat for at beskytte din krone!

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  Informazioni sul gioco        
   Costruisci - Esplora - Difendi - Conquista!  
  Un velo di mistero avvolge queste terre medievali inesplorate dove troverai antichi monumenti, reliquie e creature mitologiche. Echi di epoche passate parlano della grandezza del tempo che fu: in Kingdom Two Crowns, parte della premiata serie Kingdom, ti imbarcherai in un'avventura come Monarca. In questo viaggio a scorrimento laterale in groppa al tuo destriero, recluta sudditi leali, costruisci il tuo Regno e proteggi la tua corona dai Greed, mostruose creature decise a trafugare il tesoro del tuo Regno.
  Viaggia da solo o in compagnia: in Kingdom Two Crowns, una coppia di Monarchi può collaborare per costruire e forgiare un Regno che resista alle ingiurie del tempo.
        
  Posa le fondamenta di un Regno potente con mura imponenti e torri di guardia, mentre fai crescere la sua prosperità costruendo fattorie e reclutando abitanti dei villaggi. In Kingdom Two Crowns espandere e far crescere il tuo Regno ti dà accesso a nuove unità e tecnologie.
        
  Avventurati nell'ignoto oltre la sicurezza dei tuoi confini, attraverso foreste remote e antiche rovine, alla ricerca di tesori e conoscenze nascoste per aiutarti nella tua missione. Quali artefatti leggendari o esseri mitologici troverai? Nessuno può saperlo.
        
  Quando cala la notte, le ombre prendono vita e i mostruosi Greed si lanciano all'assalto del tuo regno. Raduna le truppe, prendi il coraggio a due mani e preparati al peggio, perché ogni notte metterà alla prova il tuo acume tattico in sfide sempre più complesse. Schiera arcieri, cavalieri, armi d'assedio e persino nuove abilità e artefatti del Monarca per resistere alle ondate dei Greed.
        
  Come Monarca, guida l'assalti contro i luoghi da cui provengono i Greed per proteggere le tue isole. Invia manipoli di soldati contro il nemico. Fai attenzione, però: assicurati che le tue truppe siano preparate e in numero sufficiente, perché i Greed venderanno cara la pelle.
        
  Kingdom Two Crowns è un'esperienza in continua evoluzione, con una serie di contenuti gratuiti:
     Shogun : viaggia in terre ispirate all'architettura e alla cultura del Giappone feudale. Vesti i panni del possente Shogun o di Onna-bugeisha; assicurati la fedeltà dei ninja, conduci le truppe in battaglia in groppa al mitologico Kirin e delinea nuove strategie per affrontare i Greed in agguato tra le fitte foreste di bambù.
     Dead Lands : esplora il lato oscuro del Regno. Gioca nei panni di monarchi unici, tra cui la Shardbinder Miriam, con potenti abilità, dal GdR d'azione horror Bloodstained.
     Isole della sfida : la sfida più complessa mai affrontata anche dai Monarchi più veterani. Affronta cinque sfide con regole e obiettivi diversi. Riuscirai a sopravvivere abbastanza a lungo da guadagnare la corona d'oro?
    La tua avventura è solo l'inizio. Esplora altre storie e ambientazioni mai raccontate nei DLC e nei contenuti aggiuntivi disponibili per il gioco. Resta vigile, Monarca, perché le notti più buie devono ancora arrivare. Proteggi la corona!

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  关于游戏        
    建造 - 探索 - 保卫 - 征服   
  
  神秘的面纱笼罩着这片未知的中世纪大地，古老的纪念碑、遗迹和神话般的生物在此等待你的到来。往昔时代的回音诉说着过去的伟大， 《王国：两位君主》 是屡获殊荣的《王国》系列游戏的一部分，你将作为君主踏上冒险之旅。在这趟横轴冒险旅程中，你将骑上坐骑，征召忠诚的臣民，建设你的王国，同时还得保护王冠不被贪婪生物夺走——这些骇人的怪物满心想着将王国的宝藏偷个一干二净。 
  
  独行还是同行 - 在《王国：两位君主》中，两位君主可以携手合作，建立并巩固一个经得起时间考验的王国。  
     
  
  
        
  建造高耸的城墙和瞭望塔，为强大的王国奠定基础，同时建造农场、征召村民，从而实现繁荣。在《王国：两位君主》中，你可以通过扩大和发展王国，获得新的臣民兵将和技术。  
   
        
  探索疆域以外的未知之地，穿过偏僻的森林和古老的废墟，寻找宝藏和隐藏的知识，协助你一路冒险。谁知道你会发现什么传奇神器或神话生灵呢？ 
  
        
  随着夜幕降临，暗影开始苏醒，骇人的贪婪生物也将袭击你的王国。召集军队、鼓起勇气、磨练自己，因为每一晚都要求你不断增长自身的战术技巧。部署弓箭手、骑士、攻城武器，甚至是新获得的君主能力和神器，来抵御贪婪生物的浪潮。 
  
        
  你作为一国之君，需要亲自率军攻击贪婪生物的源头，才能保护辖下诸岛。派遣你的部队，去与敌人交战。注意：请确保你的军队兵精粮足，因为贪婪生物不会不战而降。   
  
        
  《王国：两位君主》能带给玩家不断进化的游戏体验，包含几项免费的内容更新：
  
   幕府时代： 这片土地的灵感来自日本封建时代的建筑和文化。化身强大的幕府将军或女武士，征召忍者，骑上神兽麒麟，率军作战，一面运筹帷幄，一面鏖战竹林深处的贪婪生物。
   死亡之地： 深入王国的黑暗之地。化身哥特风恐怖动作角色扮演游戏《赤痕》中的碎片人米莉娅姆等独特的君主，获得相应的强大特性。骑上巨大的甲虫，布设陷阱；骑上诡异的不死生物，召唤障碍，阻止贪婪生物的侵袭；或者骑上《赤痕》神秘的恶魔生物加麦基，发动强大的冲刺攻击。
   挑战岛： 对于久经沙场的老练君主来说，这是有史以来最大的挑战。迎接五项规则和目标各不相同的挑战。你能尽力活下来，并夺得金王冠吗？
  你的冒险才刚刚开始。在额外的DLC和游戏内容中，探索更多不为人知的故事和场景。君主啊，请保持警惕，因为黑夜就要来临，保护好你的王冠！

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  關於此遊戲        
   建造 - 探索 - 防禦 - 征服 
  神祕的面紗籠罩著這片未知的中世紀大地，古老的紀念碑、遺跡和神話般的生物在此等待你的到來。往昔時代的回音訴說著過去的偉大，《Kingdom Two Crowns》是屢獲殊榮的《Kingdom》系列遊戲的一部分，你將化身君主，踏上冒險之旅。在這趟橫軸冒險旅程中，騎上坐騎，徵召忠誠的臣民，建設你的王國，同時還得保護王冠不被貪婪生物奪走——這些駭人的怪物滿心想著將王國的寶藏偷個一乾二淨。
  獨旅還是同行？在《Kingdom Two Crowns》中，兩位君主可以攜手合作，逐步堆砌出一個經得起時間考驗的王國。
        
  建造高聳的城牆和瞭望塔，為強大王國奠定基礎，同時建造農場、徵召村民，使王國欣欣向榮。在《Kingdom Two Crowns》中，你可以開疆闢土、增強國力，逐步獲得新的臣民兵將和技術。
        
  探索疆域以外的未知之地，穿過偏僻的森林和古老的廢墟，尋找寶藏和隱藏的知識，協助你一路冒險。誰知道你會發現什麼傳奇神器或神話生靈呢？
        
  隨著夜幕降臨，暗影開始甦醒，駭人的貪婪生物也將襲擊你的王國。召集軍隊、鼓起勇氣、磨練自己，你必須不斷增長自身的戰術技巧，才有望夜復一夜地保住性命。部署弓箭手、騎士、攻城武器，甚至是新獲得的君主能力和神器，抵禦一波又一波襲來的貪婪生物。
        
  你作為一國之君，需要親自率軍攻擊貪婪生物的源頭，才能保護轄下諸島。派遣麾下部隊挺身迎敵。注意：請確保你的軍隊兵精糧足，因為貪婪生物不會不戰而降。
        
  《Kingdom Two Crowns》帶給玩家不斷進化的遊戲體驗，包含幾項免費內容更新：
     《Shogun》 ：造訪新國度，探索以日本封建時代的文化與建築為靈感的場景。成為強大的幕府將軍或女武士，謀取忍者支持、駕馭傳說中的麒麟來率領部隊作戰，並運籌帷幄，無畏面對躲在重重竹林內的敵人。
     《Dead Lands》 ：深入王國的黑暗之地。化身成獨一無二、擁有強大特質的君主，例如哥德式恐怖動作RPG遊戲《血咒之城：暗夜儀式》的碎片人米利暗。
     挑戰島 ：對於久經沙場的老練君主來說，這是有史以來最大的挑戰。迎接五項規則和目標各不相同的挑戰。你能活得夠久，奪得最終的金王冠嗎？
    你的冒險才剛剛開始。在額外的DLC和擴充內容中，探索更多不為人知的故事和場景。君主啊，請保持警戒，因為黑夜就要來臨，保護好你的王冠！

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  ゲームについて        
   建築し、探索せよ。王国を守り、征服せよ。 
  謎に包まれた中世の未開の地には、古代の遺跡や遺物、神話の怪物が待ち受けている。過ぎ去りし時代の響きは過去の栄光を語る。『Kingdom Two Crowns』は、いくつもの賞に輝いた『Kingdom』シリーズの一作だ。1人の君主として、横スクロールの冒険に出発しよう。忠実なる民を仲間にして、自分の王国を築き、財宝を狙う欲深き怪物「グリード」から王冠を守るのだ。
  旅は1人でも、2人でも
  『Kingdom Two Crowns』では、もう1人の君主と協力しながら、2人で時間という試練に耐えうる王国を築き上げることができる。
        
  そびえ立つ壁ややぐらを建てて強大なる王国の礎を築き、村人を集め農場を作って繁栄を実現しよう。王国を拡大、成長させれば、新しいユニットや技術を手に入れることができる。
        
  国境の守りを越えて、人里離れた森や古代の遺跡など未開の地を探索しよう。冒険の助けになる宝や隠された知識を探しているうちに、伝説のアーティファクトや神話の存在と遭遇することもあるだろう。
        
  日が沈むと影に命が宿り、怪物「グリード」が王国を襲う。勇気を奮い兵を率いて戦おう。敵は夜ごとに力を増し、生き残るには卓越した戦略眼が求められる。射手や騎士、攻城兵器、さらには君主の新しい力やアーティファクトを駆使して、襲いくるグリードの大群に立ち向かうのだ。
        
  君主として、領土の島々を守るためにグリードの発生源へ攻撃を仕掛けよう。兵を送り、敵と戦うのだ。しかし、十分な兵力と入念な準備を忘れてはならない。グリードも激しい抵抗を見せるだろう。
        
  『Kingdom Two Crowns』は無料のコンテンツアップデートなど、進化を続けている。これまでの中世のステージに加え、以下のようなステージが追加されている。
     ショーグン ：封建時代の日本の建築物や文化にインスパイアされた地へ旅立とう。強力な将軍や女武芸者となり、忍者の助力を得て、兵士たちを率いて伝説の麒麟に乗って戦い、うっそうとした竹林に隠れ潜むグリードを相手に勇敢に立ち向かうための新しい戦略を練れ。
     デッドランド ：王国の邪悪な地へ足を踏み入れよう。ゴシックホラー・アクションRPG『Bloodstained』から参戦の強力な特性を持つシャードバインダーのミリアムなど、特徴的な君主となってプレイできる。
     チャレンジ島 ：歴戦の君主のために用意された史上最難関の挑戦。異なるルールと目的が設定された5つのチャレンジに挑もう。長く生き延び、金の王冠を手にすることはできるか？
    冒険はまだ始まりに過ぎない。追加DLCやコンテンツアップデートでは、知られざる物語や舞台が待っている。ああ、君主よ。迫り来る夜に備えよ、王冠を守り続けるのだ！

10 Year Anniversary Roadmap      
 
 
  About the Game        
    Build - Explore - Defend - Conquer    
  A shroud of mystery envelops these uncharted medieval lands where ancient monuments, relics and mythical creatures await. Echoes of bygone eras speak of past greatness and in Kingdom Two Crowns, part of the award-winning franchise Kingdom, you embark on an adventure as the Monarch. In this side-scrolling journey atop your steed, you recruit loyal subjects, build your kingdom and protect your crown from the Greed, monstrous creatures looking to steal your kingdom's treasures.  
  Journey alone or together - in Kingdom Two Crowns, a duo of Monarchs can work cooperatively to build and forge a Kingdom that stands the test of time.   
        
  Lay the foundation of a mighty Kingdom with towering walls and protecting towers while cultivating prosperity through building farms and recruiting villagers. In Kingdom Two Crowns expanding and growing your Kingdom grants access to new units and technologies.   
        
  Venture into the unknown beyond the protection of your borders, through secluded forests and ancient ruins to seek treasures and hidden knowledge to aid your quest. Who knows what legendary artifacts or mythological beings you will find.  
        
  As the night falls, shadows come to life and the monstrous Greed assaults your kingdom. Rally your troops, muster your courage, and steel yourself, for each night will demand ever-growing feats of tactical mastermind. Deploy archers, knights, siege weapons, and even newfound Monarch abilities and artifacts to hold against the waves of Greed.  
        
  As the monarch, lead assaults against the source of the Greed to secure your islands. Send your groups of soldiers to clash with the enemy. A word of caution: make sure your troops are prepared and sufficient in numbers, as the Greed will not go down without a fight.   
        
  Kingdom Two Crowns is an evolving experience that includes several free content updates:   
     Shogun:  Journey to lands inspired by the architecture and culture of feudal Japan. Play as the mighty Shogun or Onna-bugeisha, enlist the ninja, lead your soldiers to battle atop the mythological Kirin, and form new strategies as you brave the Greed hiding in thick bamboo forests.  
     Dead Lands:  Enter the dark lands of Kingdom. Play as unique Monarchs, including the Shardbinder Miriam, with powerful traits from the gothic horror action-RPG Bloodstained. Ride the gigantic beetle to lay out traps, the eerie undead steed that summons barriers impeding the progress of the Greed, or the mythical demon horse Gamigin from Bloodstained, with its powerful charge attack.   
     Challenge Islands:  Representing the greatest challenge ever seen for hardened veteran monarchs.  Take on five challenges with different rules and objectives. Can you survive long enough to claim the gold crown?  
    Your adventure is only the beginning. Explore more untold stories and settings in the additional DLCs and content available for the game. Oh Monarch, stay vigilant for dark nights are still to come, protect your crown!
屡获殊荣的微策略游戏系列推出了最新的升级版，在这里经营并建设您自己的王国，保护它免受贪婪生物的威胁！在全新的单人或合作战役模式里，体验新的科技、部队、敌人、坐骑和隐藏要素。

game.title: Starbound
game.description:
You’ve fled your home, only to find yourself lost in space with a damaged ship. Your only option is to beam down to the planet below and gather the resources you need to repair your ship and set off to explore the vast, infinite universe…

In Starbound, you create your own story - there’s no wrong way to play! You may choose to save the universe from the forces that destroyed your home, uncovering greater galactic mysteries in the process, or you may wish to forego a heroic journey entirely in favor of colonizing uncharted planets.
